Client Experience & Communication


  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned clients
  • Manage client communication, follow-ups, and requests
  • Support and help lead client check-ins and QBRs
  • Proactively identify and resolve client issues




Delivery & Budget Accountability


  • Track monthly deliverables across bookkeeping, controller, and CFO services
  • Ensure deadlines are met (10–15 business day close target)
  • Monitor team utilization and ensure work stays within budget
  • Flag risks early and drive resolution




Billing & Revenue Accuracy


  • Assist with client billing and invoice preparation
  • Ensure billing aligns with scope, deliverables, and hours worked
  • Identify underbilling, missed charges, and scope creep
  • Help maintain consistent and scalable billing processes




Upsells & Account Growth


  • Identify opportunities for additional services (CFO, cleanup, add-ons)
  • Surface opportunities to leadership and support execution
  • Ensure clients are properly scoped as they grow




Onboarding


  • Support onboarding of new clients
  • Coordinate data collection, access, and system setup
  • Ensure a smooth transition into recurring workflows




Team Coordination


  • Work closely with offshore accounting team (Philippines) and U.S.-based CFOs
  • Maintain clear communication and accountability across teams
  • Identify performance gaps and escalate when needed




Operations & Process Improvement


  • Help build and refine SOPs across onboarding, delivery, and billing
  • Identify inefficiencies and implement improvements
  • Support operational structure as the company scales




What Success Looks Like


  • Clients are satisfied, retained, and not escalating issues
  • Monthly closes are consistently on time
  • Work is delivered within budgeted hours
  • Billing is accurate, complete, and timely
  • Upsell opportunities are identified and acted on
  • Leadership is not pulled into day-to-day execution




Qualifications


  • 2–5+ years of experience in operations, client services, or service-based businesses
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Comfortable managing multiple clients and priorities
  • Ability to hold team members accountable in a professional way
  • Experience in accounting, finance, or professional services is a strong plus
  • Experience with tools like QuickBooks, HubSpot, or similar platforms is a plus




Compensation


  • Base Salary: $24,000 – $42,000 USD (depending on experience)



Performance Bonus


  • Annual bonus tied to client retention
  • Additional upside tied to upsell support and revenue growth




Why AdaptCFO


  • Fully remote team
  • High ownership role with direct impact on the business
  • Clear path to leadership as the company grows
  • Exposure to U.S.-based clients and finance operations
  • Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment

title: Full-Stack Developer

title: Analista de P&D - Golang/C++
description:
Já pensou em trabalhar em uma empresa líder global em dados, insights, consultoria e que contribui para o sucesso e crescimento das principais organizações do mundo?

Então essa é a sua chance!



Buscamos: Analista de P&D - Golang/C++



Resumo do Propósito da Função:

Esta função oferece uma empolgante posição de desenvolvimento de software na equipe de Engenharia, uma organização multicultural com times baseados na Europa e na América do Sul, responsável por pesquisar e desenvolver soluções de hardware e software para sistemas de medição de audiência utilizados globalmente.

Este profissional fará parte da equipe responsável pelos sistemas de correspondência de áudio desenvolvidos pelo IBOPE, que estão sendo implementados em diversos países. Esse sistema compara áudios coletados por dispositivos de medição dedicados com uma biblioteca de conteúdos de TV, utilizando a tecnologia proprietária de correspondência de áudio do IBOPE (técnica de fingerprinting).

O IBOPE possui sistemas desenvolvidos tanto para ambientes on-premises quanto em nuvem, utilizando uma abordagem agnóstica de cloud. Sua arquitetura é composta por diversas tecnologias de ponta, como containers, Kubernetes, entre outras.



Esta função envolve:

  • Manutenção de tecnologias existentes baseadas em Linux para ambientes on-premises.
  • Pesquisa, criação e desenvolvimento de aplicações — baseadas em charts do Kubernetes e/ou disponíveis na CNCF (Cloud Native Computing Foundation) — responsáveis por comunicação, busca otimizada em grandes volumes de dados, armazenamento de dados e mais, utilizando tecnologias e técnicas avançadas.
  • Manutenção de pipelines.
  • Melhoria do código por meio da adição de ferramentas para avaliação da qualidade do código.



RESPONSABILIDADES:

  • Manter tecnologias existentes implantadas em vários países.
  • Implementar novas tecnologias para sistemas de medição de audiência com base em tecnologias existentes e novas.
  • Pesquisar novas tecnologias para aprimorar o produto.
  • Desenvolver novos serviços.
  • Criar novos charts do Kubernetes.
  • Garantir a comunicação dos containers Kubernetes dentro e fora dos clusters.
  • Manter a tecnologia atual.




REQUISITOS:


Essencial:

  • Superior completo ou cursando último ano na área de tecnologia.
  • Experiência com Linux / bash scripting.
  • Sólidos conhecimentos em C++ and/or Golang
  • TDD – metodologia de testes
  • Experiência com SQL database e NoSQL database.
  • Inglês avançado para conversas técnicas e documentação.



Desejável:

  • Javascript
  • Kubernetes
  • AKS
  • Terraform
  • Monitoring systems
  • Prometheus Stack
  • Messaging (RabbitMQ)




O que oferecemos?

Além de um clima descontraído e total open space, compartilhamos de alguns outros benefícios que trazem qualidade de vida e muita felicidade:



  • Vale Refeição e Alimentação
  • Horário Flexível
  • Modelo de trabalho remoto
  • Assistência Médica e Odontológica
  • Convênio Farmácia
  • Participação nos Lucros e Resultados
  • Previdência Privada
  • Licença Maternidade com duração de 6 meses
  • Licença Paternidade estendida com duração de 20 dias
  • Licença Maternidade/Paternidade para casais homoafetivos
  • Convênio com empresas parceiras
  • Programa de Qualidade de vida: Convênio com academias, palestras sobre temas relevantes, vacinação contra a gripe; Programa Global de Assistência ao colaborador e seus familiares (assistência jurídica, psicológica ou financeira) e muito mais
  • Programa de Mobilidade Interna: valorizamos talentos internos e por isso as vagas disponíveis são divulgadas internamente possibilitando ao colaborador mudar de área ou divisão diferente da que atua



Se o seu perfil corresponde aos nossos valores e objetivos, deixe seu currículo conosco e não perca a chance de fazer parte de nossa equipe. Esperamos por você!



No IBOPE a diversidade faz parte do negócio, gerando inovação e resultados. Não fazemos distinção de raça, religião, nacionalidade, gênero, identidade de gênero, orientação sexual, idade, deficiência, gravidez, estado civil ou qualquer outra forma de discriminação.

title: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior - Oracle Cloud (OCI)
description:
Oportunidade: Engenheiro de Dados Sênior - Oracle Cloud (OCI)


Estamos em busca de um(a) Engenheiro(a) de Dados Sênior para atuar em projetos estratégicos de dados, com foco em arquitetura, integração e processamento de dados na Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI). O profissional será responsável por desenvolver e otimizar pipelines de dados em uma arquitetura medallion (Bronze, Prata e Ouro, , integrando fontes heterogêneas — incluindo Oracle Fusion Analytics, APIs, Bancos de Dados e plataformas diversas — garantindo escalabilidade, performance e qualidade das informações utilizadas pelas áreas de negócio.


Responsabilidades:

- Desenvolver, manter e otimizar pipelines de dados em ambientes Oracle Cloud, com foco em Oracle Cloud Data Integration e Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW).

- Construir e gerenciar integrações de dados via APIs REST e ingestão de arquivos (CSV, JSON, XML, Parquet) a partir de fontes heterogêneas.

- Extrair e harmonizar dados do Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW), consolidando informações financeiras e operacionais no Data Lake.

- Modelar e estruturar dados nas camadas analíticas para suportar soluções de BI e relatórios analíticos em Power BI.

- Trabalhar com processos de ingestão, transformação e disponibilização de dados (ETL/ELT) respeitando a arquitetura de camadas do Data Lake.

- Apoiar a construção e manutenção do Catálogo de Dados no OCI, incluindo descoberta, linhagem e glossário.

- Garantir boas práticas de governança, qualidade e segurança de dados.

- Atuar em colaboração com times de arquitetura, analytics e áreas de negócio para entender demandas e propor soluções escaláveis.


Requisitos Necessários:

- Experiência sólida como Engenheiro(a) de Dados em projetos sobre Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI).

- Experiência com OCI Data Integration ou ferramenta equivalente de orquestração e transformação de dados em Oracle Cloud.

- Conhecimento em Oracle Autonomous Data Warehouse (ADW) e Oracle Object Storage.

- Experiência com integração de dados via APIs REST e múltiplas fontes de dados heterogêneas.

- Experiência com SQL avançado e modelagem de dados (dimensional e analítica).

- Vivência com arquiteturas modernas de Data Lake em cloud, incluindo padrões de camadas de dados (medallion ou equivalente).

- Vivência com ferramentas de ETL/ELT e integração de dados.

- Experiência com linguagens de programação voltadas a dados (Python ou similar).


Diferenciais:

- Experiência com Oracle Fusion Analytics Warehouse (FAW) — extração e entendimento do modelo de dados do Fusion.

- Vivência com Oracle Data Catalog para gestão de metadados e linhagem de dados.

- Experiência com Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC) para integração de sistemas.

- Familiaridade com Power BI como camada de consumo dos dados estruturados.


Modelo de Trabalho

- Remoto

- Contratação PJ


Benefícios ATRA:

- TotalPass

- Reembolso 100% em certificações

- Parcerias educacionais

- Trilhas de capacitação e comunidades técnicas

- Projetos desafiadores com tecnologias de ponta


Sobre a ATRA

Somos uma consultoria brasileira com +15 anos de mercado, especializada em Dados, Analytics, Engenharia, Governança e IA. Atuamos com grandes empresas e somos parceiros de líderes como Google, Microsoft, Databricks, Informatica, Denodo e BigID. Trabalhamos com tecnologia, mas nosso foco sempre é gente.

title: MS D365 CRM Functional Consultant
description:
We never request payment at any stage of our recruitment process, and we only contact candidates through official corporate accounts and platforms. If you are approached with any request for payment, it is likely fraudulent. Please verify whether the role you are interested in is posted on our official website.



About TMF Group

TMF Group is a leading global provider of high-value business services to clients operating and investing worldwide. We deliver specialized, business‑critical financial and administrative services that enable our clients to operate their corporate structures, finance vehicles and investment funds across multiple jurisdictions.



Discover the Role

We are seeking a CRM Business Analyst / CRM Functional Consultant who will play a key role in gathering business requirements and supporting implementations of Microsoft Dynamics 365 (D365) . The ideal candidate is resourceful, detail‑oriented, self‑driven and committed to deeply understanding business needs and translating them into effective technical solutions.

Strong listening skills, collaboration, openness to feedback and a sense of ownership are essential to success in this role. If you are driven by challenge, enjoy going the extra mile and want to work with highly talented professionals, this is the opportunity for you.

If you are an experienced Microsoft D365 CRM Functional Consultant seeking dynamic projects and a collaborative team, we encourage you to apply.



Key Responsibilities

  • Gather and document business requirements in collaboration with stakeholders.
  • Implement Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM solutions tailored to business needs.
  • Configure and customize D365 CRM to meet functional requirements.
  • Work closely with technical teams to integrate CRM with other systems.
  • Participate in project planning, estimating and project management activities.
  • Deliver end‑user training and provide ongoing functional support.
  • Maintain up‑to‑date knowledge of new D365 CRM features and capabilities.
  • Mentor and guide junior consultants when needed.


Key Requirements

  • Experience in Microsoft Dynamics 365 CRM implementation and customization.
  • Experience with version 8.0 or later.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Experience developing custom workflows, entities and plugins using C# or .NET .
  • Strong understanding of D365 CRM’s data model, security model and configuration options.
  • Excellent analytical, problem‑solving and critical‑thinking skills.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills.
  • Ability to work independently or in a team environment.



What’s in It for You?

Career Development

  • Opportunities for internal mobility and career progression.
  • Collaboration with global colleagues and exposure to international clients.
  • Continuous learning supported by the TMF Business Academy.

Making an Impact

  • Direct contribution to simplifying global business operations for our clients.
  • Opportunities to support local communities through our corporate social responsibility initiatives.

A Supportive Environment

  • A strong feedback culture that supports growth and engagement.
  • Flexibility to work from our offices or remotely, promoting work‑life balance.
  • An inclusive environment where people are empowered and encouraged to grow their careers.

At TMF Group, our people define who we are . We thrive on entrepreneurial spirit and value proactive professionals who bring passion, accountability and excellence to everything they do.

title: CSOD
description:
About NIIT


At NIIT, we’re transforming the way the world learns, for the better. That’s why the world’s best run learning functions across the globe trust us with their learning and talent. Since 1981, we have helped leading companies transform their learning ecosystems while increasing the business value of learning. Our comprehensive, high impact managed learning solutions weave together the best of learning theory, technology, operations, and services to enable a thriving workforce.

NIIT operates in over 40 countries, including the UK, Ireland, France and Germany. Due to rapid expansion in Europe, the company now seeks a new dynamic Business Development Director to significantly increase sales to Fortune 500 companies across Europe.


Link to NIIT LinkedIn page -


Title : CSOD Implementation consultant


Job Description:


We are seeking an experienced Compensation Expert with strong expertise in Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD)

Serve as a course implementation expert to our primarily partners to help drive our course deployments

  • Understand and apply comprehensive learning operations knowledge to execute effective course deployment strategies to global audiences.
  • Strong and effective in written, verbal, and presentation skills
  • Analyze and provide recommendations to address existing problems.
  • Develops creative solutions in preparation for unforeseen issues.
  • Apply analytical and critical thinking skills quickly and accurately in a high-pressure situation
  • Detail-oriented, data-driven, and customer-focused professional who can pivot priorities based on changing business needs
  • Support our internal community by driving impact through collaborative working relationships
  • Be able to network with, and appropriately identify and involve key internal stakeholders to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings
  • Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working within the context of a new team in the process of building out an operations program
  • Operate independently in fast moving, stressful situations while managing mission critical tasks
  • Anticipate needs before being asked, identify opportunities to improve processes and create efficiencies
  • Be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing workloads to meet competing deadlines
  • Provide clear and constant communication and escalate issues in a timely manner

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain project plan and complete operational processes and deliverables to help ensure effective, trouble-free e-Learn and in-person course launches to our targeted audiences
  • Actively and effectively partner with L&D Program Managers and SMEs to support new and ongoing course deployments
  • Document and provide course deployment requirements (e.g. reoccurrence) which informs the correct course configurations and assignment of course curriculums
  • Draft and maintain course playbooks, key deployment changes, course requirements, and other standard operating procedure documents
  • Track and report course key metrics and performance measures to key stakeholder as required
  • Drive course impact by leveraging data to implement best practices that increase enrollment, discoverability, and consumption of our learning content
  • Develop and document effective course communication escalation strategies to help drive compliance course completions
  • Provide oversight for e-Learning course maintenance, ILT event management, class session forecasting, group / target audience assignments, and learner enrollments for all assigned programs
  • Prepare and facilitate course quarterly business review meetings with stakeholders
  • Provide course learner support for assigned courses by resolving issues or routing cases to appropriate team members to resolve
  • Work with People Operations, Engineering (Eng), People Insights, and Data teams to root cause potential LMS, reporting, or learner support issues
  • Drive the execution of all learning related audit control testing and support any operational audit initiatives
  • Identify and communicate system and process issues to L&D and make recommendations on programs to drive operational efficiencies


NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

description:
Quem Somos

A Dexian, lançada em 2023, tem presença global e traz consigo quase 30 anos de experiência através de suas companhias legadas, principalmente da combinação da DISYS e Signature Consultants.

Iniciamos no Brasil 2007 como DISYS e, de lá para cá, conquistamos mais de 50 clientes de diferentes setores da economia. Como Dexian, passamos a ser uma das maiores empresas de contratação e solução de TI e estamos liderando a indústria por meio de entrega de serviços exclusivos que combina escala global, recursos de serviço completo e agilidade tática para modernizar modelos de contratação, avançar em soluções de mão-de-obra e transformar a infraestrutura tecnológica. Contamos com escritórios estrategicamente localizados em quatro grandes capitais: Curitiba (PR), Porto Alegre (RS), Rio de Janeiro (RJ) e São Paulo (SP). Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.


O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Por isso, atuamos como ponte entre profissionais altamente qualificados e oportunidades consistentes e prósperas. Acreditamos que, trazer o talento, a tecnologia e as organizações certas juntos, ajuda a desbloquear resultados transformadores e alcançar novos níveis de sucessos para os clientes que atendemos e os consultores que contratamos. E para isso, cinco valores fundamentais nos guiam: Integridade, Transparencia, Autenticidade, Engenhosidade e Empatia. Compartilha dos mesmos valores, aqui é seu lugar! Que tal desenvolver sua carreira conosco?

Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.


Atividades que este profissional irá exercer :

Um(a) profissional híbrido(a) e curioso(a), que transita com confiança entre desenvolvimento web e engenharia de dados, com maturidade técnica para construir soluções completas — desde a ingestão de dados até a interface final do usuário.


Responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver aplicações web responsivas utilizando Angular (TypeScript/HTML/CSS).
  • Construir e manter serviços de backend e APIs em .NET, integrando dados provenientes do Snowflake.
  • Projetar pipelines de dados e arquiteturas de dados de ponta a ponta usando Snowflake, SQL avançado, Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob e boas práticas de engenharia de dados.
  • Criar e otimizar consultas e modelos de dados em MSSQL.
  • Aplicar clean code, padrões de projeto e desenvolver testes unitários.
  • Containerizar aplicações utilizando Docker e realizar o deploy de soluções em ambientes Azure.
  • Colaborar com equipes multifuncionais para entregar soluções técnicas de ponta a ponta.


Qualificações

  • Graduação em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia ou área relacionada (ou experiência equivalente).
  • 3 a 7+ anos de experiência em engenharia de dados (ajustável conforme a senioridade).
  • Histórico comprovado na construção de sistemas de dados robustos em ambientes de nuvem.
  • Forte capacidade de resolução de problemas e habilidade para atuar em ambientes dinâmicos e multifuncionais.
  • Inglês avançado (escrito e falado) — capaz de se comunicar com confiança com stakeholders globais.


Requisitos técnicos:

Full Stack

  • Angular (TypeScript / HTML / CSS)
  • .NET (C#, APIs, integrações)
  • Clean code, padrões de projeto e testes unitários
  • Azure (App Services, DevOps, CI/CD)
  • Docker
  • MSSQL

Engenharia de Dados

  • Snowflake
  • SQL avançado (modelagem e otimização)
  • Azure Data Factory, Azure Blob e desenvolvimento de pipelines de ponta a ponta
  • Arquitetura de dados / ELT / padrões de integração


Desejáveis:

  • Databricks
  • Python
  • SAP HANA
  • Qlik
  • Integração de APIs
  • LLMs (Large Language Models) e IA aplicada

Há 31 anos no mercado, a BRQ Digital Solutions se consolidou como uma das maiores empresas de transformação digital do país. Experiência internacional: Estamos crescendo cada vez mais fora do Brasil e você tem possibilidade de atuar em projetos para outros países, ou diretamente nos países onde a BRQ tem sede.


Empreendedorismo: De funcionário para sócio! Temos o Innovation Hub, a Corporate Venture que investe em ideias de profissionais que tenham sinergia com nosso negócio.

Plano de Saúde; Plano Odontológico; Seguro de Vida; Vale Refeição; Vale Alimentação; Horário Flexível; Gympass, Telemedicina, Telenutrição, Canal de suporte emocional 24h e muito mais!

title: Desenvolvedor Full Stack
description:
Este(a) profissional ficará alocado dentro do time ART (Advanced Rail Tecnology) atuando em projetos de tecnologia aplicáveis a ferrovias, com a oportunidade de interface direta junto a times globais. Para ser bem-sucedido(a) nesta posição, além de sólida experiência em back-end e Front-End, é essencial que o(a) profissional tenha um nível de inglês avançado e competências como proatividade, capacidade de liderança e comunicação. Estamos fazendo história na indústria ferroviária e você pode fazer parte disso!


Quem somos:

Somos a Progress Rail, uma empresa do grupo Caterpillar, e um dos maiores fornecedores de soluções e tecnologias de material rodante e infraestrutura para o setor ferroviário global.


Propósito do cargo

Criar aplicações das tecnologias web completas, criando aplicações do zero e integrando-as com outras ferramentas vigentes, a fim de entregar um trabalho com aplicações de qualidade e completas.


Tarefas Detalhadas:

  • Desenvolver aplicações Java escaláveis e resilientes, com foco em arquitetura orientada a alta performance e excelente experiência do usuário em ambientes web e desktop.
  • Construção de interfaces modernas com Angular: Utilizar Angular com TypeScript, HTML5, para desenvolver interfaces dinâmicas e responsivas.
  • Debugging e otimização contínua: Diagnosticar e corrigir bugs e aplicar melhorias para garantir eficiência, segurança e escalabilidade das aplicações.
  • Colaboração multidisciplinar: Coordenar o fluxo de trabalho com desenvolvedores front-end e back-end, promovendo sinergia na construção de APIs RESTful e interfaces intuitivas.
  • Ambiente com metodologias ágeis: Atuar utilizando frameworks ágeis como Scrum e Kanban para garantir entregas contínuas e colaborativas.
  • Segurança e proteção de dados: Implementar práticas modernas de segurança, como criptografia, autenticação robusta e prevenção contra vulnerabilidades.
  • Otimizar a usabilidade e a performance da aplicação, desenvolvendo funcionalidades que simplifiquem a navegação e aumentem a eficiência da interação do usuário com o sistema.


Requisitos:

  • Experiência sólida em desenvolvimento de aplicações web, atuando em projetos com foco em escalabilidade, performance e arquitetura bem definida.
  • Domínio avançado em Java, com vivência prática em Core Java e frameworks como Spring (Spring Core, Spring MVC, Spring Boot), Hibernate e construção de APIs RESTful seguindo princípios de design orientado a recursos.
  • Conhecimento em Angular (versão 10+) como framework principal de front-end.
  • Familiaridade com bibliotecas complementares, como Bootstrap e jQuery, com foco em compatibilidade e responsividade.
  • Experiência com ferramentas de build e versionamento, como Maven/Gradle, Git/GitHub, além de práticas de integração contínua com Jenkins e uso de containers via Docker.
  • Vivência com ambientes em nuvem (AWS), experiência com computação em nuvem AWS e banco de dados relacionais e não relacionais.
  • Participação ativa em times ágeis, utilizando metodologias como Scrum e Kanban, com envolvimento em rituais como planning, daily, reviews e retrospectivas.


Diferenciais:

  • Conhecimento teórico e prático em Gerência de Configuração de Software (itens de configuração, versionamento, baselines, releases e auditorias).
  • Experiência na definição e implantação de processos formais de CM em ambientes de desenvolvimento.
  • Integração de práticas de CM com DevOps, CI/CD e métodos ágeis.


Idioma:

Inglês avançado (capacidade de leitura e conversação).


Formação:

Nível Superior em Análise e Desenvolvimento de Sistemas, Ciência da Computação, Análise de Sistemas, Engenharia da Computação, Engenharia de Software ou similares.


Habilidades

  • Compatibilidade com Nossos Valores em Ação (Código de Conduta da Caterpillar);
  • Proatividade: É capaz de identificar e de maneira autônoma e antecipada solucionar problemas.
  • Comunicação: É capaz de expressar com clareza, ideias, pensamentos e conceitos, de forma a influenciar outros ou obter apoio.
  • Atenção a Detalhes: É capaz de verificar e interpretar fatos, planos ou projetos de forma minuciosa, contribuindo para qualidade e análise de impacto.
  • Flexibilidade: É capaz de administrar mudanças corporativas, conforme demandas de negócio, adaptando-se no ritmo necessário.


O que estamos oferecendo para esta posição:

  • Contrato CLT
  • Plano de saúde para você e seus dependentes
  • Plano odontológico para você e seus dependentes

  • Vale Alimentação
  • Seguro de vida
  • Aplicativo para descontos em academias
  • Aplicativo para descontos em medicamentos em farmácias

title: CSOD
description:
About NIIT


At NIIT, we’re transforming the way the world learns, for the better. That’s why the world’s best run learning functions across the globe trust us with their learning and talent. Since 1981, we have helped leading companies transform their learning ecosystems while increasing the business value of learning. Our comprehensive, high impact managed learning solutions weave together the best of learning theory, technology, operations, and services to enable a thriving workforce.

NIIT operates in over 40 countries, including the UK, Ireland, France and Germany. Due to rapid expansion in Europe, the company now seeks a new dynamic Business Development Director to significantly increase sales to Fortune 500 companies across Europe.


Link to NIIT LinkedIn page -


Title : CSOD Implementation consultant


Job Description:


We are seeking an experienced Compensation Expert with strong expertise in Cornerstone OnDemand (CSOD)

Serve as a course implementation expert to our primarily partners to help drive our course deployments

  • Understand and apply comprehensive learning operations knowledge to execute effective course deployment strategies to global audiences.
  • Strong and effective in written, verbal, and presentation skills
  • Analyze and provide recommendations to address existing problems.
  • Develops creative solutions in preparation for unforeseen issues.
  • Apply analytical and critical thinking skills quickly and accurately in a high-pressure situation
  • Detail-oriented, data-driven, and customer-focused professional who can pivot priorities based on changing business needs
  • Support our internal community by driving impact through collaborative working relationships
  • Be able to network with, and appropriately identify and involve key internal stakeholders to influence outcomes in cross-functional settings
  • Comfortable dealing with ambiguity and working within the context of a new team in the process of building out an operations program
  • Operate independently in fast moving, stressful situations while managing mission critical tasks
  • Anticipate needs before being asked, identify opportunities to improve processes and create efficiencies
  • Be able to handle multiple projects simultaneously, prioritizing workloads to meet competing deadlines
  • Provide clear and constant communication and escalate issues in a timely manner

Responsibilities:

  • Maintain project plan and complete operational processes and deliverables to help ensure effective, trouble-free e-Learn and in-person course launches to our targeted audiences
  • Actively and effectively partner with L&D Program Managers and SMEs to support new and ongoing course deployments
  • Document and provide course deployment requirements (e.g. reoccurrence) which informs the correct course configurations and assignment of course curriculums
  • Draft and maintain course playbooks, key deployment changes, course requirements, and other standard operating procedure documents
  • Track and report course key metrics and performance measures to key stakeholder as required
  • Drive course impact by leveraging data to implement best practices that increase enrollment, discoverability, and consumption of our learning content
  • Develop and document effective course communication escalation strategies to help drive compliance course completions
  • Provide oversight for e-Learning course maintenance, ILT event management, class session forecasting, group / target audience assignments, and learner enrollments for all assigned programs
  • Prepare and facilitate course quarterly business review meetings with stakeholders
  • Provide course learner support for assigned courses by resolving issues or routing cases to appropriate team members to resolve
  • Work with People Operations, Engineering (Eng), People Insights, and Data teams to root cause potential LMS, reporting, or learner support issues
  • Drive the execution of all learning related audit control testing and support any operational audit initiatives
  • Identify and communicate system and process issues to L&D and make recommendations on programs to drive operational efficiencies


NIIT is an equal opportunity employer. We evaluate qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.

title: AWS Data Engineer | Senior (Remote)
description:
Responsabilidades e atribuições


  • Construir e otimizar pipelines de dados para suportar arquiteturas de IA generativa;
  • Realizar ingestão, limpeza, transformação e organização de grandes volumes de dados técnicos;
  • Estruturar e preparar documentos complexos (normas, requisitos, templates), incluindo técnicas de chunking para uso em modelos de linguagem;
  • Implementar e gerenciar bases de conhecimento com busca vetorial (RAG);
  • Desenvolver e manter pipelines automatizados de dados com foco em performance e escalabilidade;
  • Estruturar datasets para treinamento de modelos (Supervised Fine-Tuning e Reinforcement Fine-Tuning);
  • Definir e organizar inputs, outputs esperados e critérios de avaliação dos modelos;
  • Garantir governança, qualidade, segurança e rastreabilidade dos dados;
  • Atuar na otimização do consumo de tokens e eficiência dos modelos;
  • Suportar análises comparativas de performance entre diferentes abordagens de IA;
  • Trabalhar em conjunto com times de IA, engenharia e negócio, garantindo alinhamento técnico e funcional.



Requisitos e qualificações

  • Forte domínio na construção de pipelines de dados (ETL/ELT);
  • Experiência com processamento e preparação de dados para IA/ML;
  • Conhecimento prático em arquiteturas de IA generativa (RAG, Fine-Tuning, embeddings);
  • Experiência com manipulação e estruturação de dados não estruturados (documentos técnicos);
  • Vivência com serviços de cloud AWS;
  • Experiência com serviços como Amazon Bedrock;
  • Conhecimento em bancos de dados vetoriais e técnicas de busca semântica;
  • Domínio em Python e SQL;
  • Experiência com práticas de governança e segurança de dados;
  • Vivência com automação e versionamento de pipelines.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Full Stack Web
description:
Venha integrar um time de excelência, somos a Eyemobile uma startup que nasceu para revolucionar o varejo! ✨


Nossa missão é simplificar a forma como negócios vendem através de inovação e tecnologia.


Estamos há 12 anos no mercado, e em nossa história, temos muitos aprendizados e conquistas, que nos ajudaram a construir uma cultura sólida, com base em três pilares: o Cuidar, Imaginar e Simplificar. Tudo isso pensando em nossos clientes, parceiros, colaboradores e na tecnologia.


Se você se identifica com valores como: Simplicidade, Agilidade, Confiança, Inovação e Experiência do Cliente , já está há um passo à frente! Então, continue lendo para conhecer mais sobre essa oportunidade que pode mudar sua carreira!


➡️ Buscamos por um(a) Desenvolvedor(a) Full Stack com experiência sólida em JavaScript/TypeScript para atuar em projetos de alta complexidade e escalabilidade que suportam os nossos produtos de PDV, Totem de autoatendimento e Portal de Gestão. Você fará parte de um time que constrói soluções modernas utilizando React no front-end e Node.js no back-end, integrando serviços em nuvem AWS e garantindo qualidade em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento.


No seu dia a dia estas serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Desenvolver e manter aplicações web utilizando React no front-end.
  • Criar e otimizar APIs RESTful e serviços com Node.js e frameworks como Fastify, Express, NestJS e Koa.js .
  • Integrar sistemas internos e externos (ERPs, adquirentes, gateways de pagamento).
  • Modelar e gerenciar bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MySQL, MongoDB, Redis ).
  • Implementar pipelines de CI/CD em BitBucket e GitLab .
  • Trabalhar com infraestrutura em AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, RDS, SQS, EventBridge, S3, CloudWatch, Cognito, entre outros).
  • Participar ativamente de decisões técnicas e revisão de código.
  • Colaborar com times de mobile e produto para garantir coesão entre as camadas
  • Monitorar aplicações e serviços utilizando CloudWatch e ferramentas correlatas.
  • Garantir versionamento e boas práticas de colaboração com Git .
  • Apoiar processos de deploy, rollout e acompanhamento de entregas.
  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança nas entregas.


Para desempenhar estas atividades entendemos que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência comprovada em JavaScript/TypeScript . Conhecimento avançado em React e Node.js .
  • Vivência com frameworks back-end (Fastify, Express, NestJS, Koa.js ).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MySQL, MongoDB, Redis ).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de CI/CD e ferramentas como BitBucket/GitLab .
  • Experiência com AWS e seus principais serviços.
  • Domínio de Git para versionamento e colaboração.


Diferenciais técnicos:

  • Experiência em arquiteturas serverless.
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Vivência com integrações com sistemas externos (ex: adquirentes, ERPs, gateways de pagamento)
  • Conhecimento de estratégias de segurança e observabilidade em APIs REST (rate limiting, circuit breaker, tracing, etc.)
  • Participação em projetos com alto volume transacional e requisitos de alta disponibilidade


Stack e Ferramentas

  • Linguagem: JavaScript (ES6+) / TypeScript
  • Front-end: React (SPA, Hooks, Context API, boas práticas de componentização)
  • Runtime: Node.js
  • Frameworks: Fastfy, Express, NestJS, Koa.js
  • Banco de dados: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
  • CI/CD: BitBucket, GitLab
  • Infraestrutura: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, RDS, SQS, EventBridge, S3, CloudWatch, Cognito, etc.)
  • Monitoramento: CloudWatch, etc.
  • Versionamento: Git
  • Boas Práticas: Clean Code, SOLID, testes automatizados, integração contínua e cultura DevOps


O que oferecemos

  • Atuação em produtos críticos com desafios reais de performance e escalabilidade
  • Ambiente técnico colaborativo e com autonomia para decisões arquiteturais
  • Flexibilidade de trabalho remoto ou híbrido
  • Acesso a produtos reais com grande volume de transações


Mais informações:

  • Possuir CNPJ ativo (nosso modelo de contratação é PJ - Prestador de Serviço);
  • Vagas remota e com horários flexíveis;
  • Temos 2 vagas (uma nível PL e outra SR).

title: Jr Partnerships Manager
description:
We are looking for a full-time, remote Partnership Programs Specialist with a strong communication skills and background in sales to join our U.S. client. The right candidates will play a vital role in supporting and executing partnership initiatives that drive growth and value for our client. Reporting to the Director of Partnerships, this role focuses on coordinating and implementing partnership programs, ensuring seamless execution and alignment with strategic goals.

The Partner Programs Specialist is responsible for providing accurate information about the company and its services. The specialist is required to keep accurate records of all time spent on calls, as well as customer-related questions or assistance. All phone calls are recorded.

Our client is on a mission provide technology and services that enable veterinary practices to provide the highest quality of care to pet owners. The company is well-funded, growth-stage company comprising individuals that thrive in a fast-paced, passionate, and entrepreneurial environment. Our client has thousands (and counting) of veterinarians within its customer base today.


Responsibilities

  • Engage with customers and prospects via phone, email, and messaging to generate sales
  • Leveraging various platforms and tools such as Salesforce, Salesloft, Chorus, Chili Piper, and more
  • Make a minimum of 40 outbound calls per day as well as send nurture emails promoting our client's value
  • Meet and exceed monthly goals
  • Work with multiple internal teams to ensure that the customer experience is seamless


Required Experience

  • Excellent English communication skills
  • 1-3 years of call center sales or remote sales experience
  • Highly motivated with a strong sense of ambition, self-discipline, and a commitment to both personal and professional development
  • Confident, energetic, and skilled communicator
  • Team player, who excels in cross-departmental collaboration
  • Driven by a competitive spirit and a passion for success!
  • Commitment to constant learning and continual growth as our client builds a better veterinary experience together, and are looking for people who will make our culture and technology even better
  • A collaborative approach, a can-do attitude, and a relentless pursuit to attain goals and solve problems
  • Trustworthy, team-oriented, and transparent


Desired Experience

  • Experience working in the veterinary space and/or sales


Additional Information

  • Knowing your ideas are heard and matter think big!
  • You get to own your job and be recognized for your contributions
  • Work with smart and creative people
  • Making mistakes is human. Lets learn from them. Be transparent!
  • We recognize you as an individual no presumptions or judgment. Be the extraordinary you!
  • Start: ASAP


About Velozient

We are a privately held, nearshore software development company providing outsourced development resources to North American companies. Our mission is to offer development talent that enjoy taking on challenging work, want to grow their skills and experiences building software, and excel in a fast-paced, dynamic team environment. We are focused on providing world-class remote resources to work as valued client team members. If this type of opportunity excites you, then consider joining our team!

title: Client Experience Specialist
description:
Overview


AdaptCFO is a fast-growing outsourced accounting and finance firm supporting small and mid-sized businesses across the U.S.


We are hiring a Client Experience Specialist to own the day-to-day execution of client delivery, billing accuracy, and operational coordination across the business.


This role sits at the center of our organization, working directly with clients, our accounting team, and leadership to ensure:


  • Deliverables are completed on time and within budget
  • Billing is accurate and aligned with work performed
  • Clients are supported and retained
  • Operational processes run efficiently as we scale


Success in this role means creating a consistent, reliable client experience while reducing internal bottlenecks and identifying opportunities for growth.


This is a high-impact, hands-on role with a clear path into leadership as the company grows.




Key Responsibilities



Client Experience & Communication


  • Serve as a primary point of contact for assigned clients
  • Manage client communication, follow-ups, and requests
  • Support and help lead client check-ins and QBRs
  • Proactively identify and resolve client issues




Delivery & Budget Accountability


  • Track monthly deliverables across bookkeeping, controller, and CFO services
  • Ensure deadlines are met (10–15 business day close target)
  • Monitor team utilization and ensure work stays within budget
  • Flag risks early and drive resolution




Billing & Revenue Accuracy


  • Assist with client billing and invoice preparation
  • Ensure billing aligns with scope, deliverables, and hours worked
  • Identify underbilling, missed charges, and scope creep
  • Help maintain consistent and scalable billing processes




Upsells & Account Growth


  • Identify opportunities for additional services (CFO, cleanup, add-ons)
  • Surface opportunities to leadership and support execution
  • Ensure clients are properly scoped as they grow




Onboarding


  • Support onboarding of new clients
  • Coordinate data collection, access, and system setup
  • Ensure a smooth transition into recurring workflows




Team Coordination


  • Work closely with offshore accounting team (Philippines) and U.S.-based CFOs
  • Maintain clear communication and accountability across teams
  • Identify performance gaps and escalate when needed




Operations & Process Improvement


  • Help build and refine SOPs across onboarding, delivery, and billing
  • Identify inefficiencies and implement improvements
  • Support operational structure as the company scales




What Success Looks Like


  • Clients are satisfied, retained, and not escalating issues
  • Monthly closes are consistently on time
  • Work is delivered within budgeted hours
  • Billing is accurate, complete, and timely
  • Upsell opportunities are identified and acted on
  • Leadership is not pulled into day-to-day execution




Qualifications


  • 2–5+ years of experience in operations, client services, or service-based businesses
  • Strong written and verbal English communication skills
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail
  • Comfortable managing multiple clients and priorities
  • Ability to hold team members accountable in a professional way
  • Experience in accounting, finance, or professional services is a strong plus
  • Experience with tools like QuickBooks, HubSpot, or similar platforms is a plus




Compensation


  • Base Salary: $24,000 – $42,000 USD (depending on experience)



Performance Bonus


  • Annual bonus tied to client retention
  • Additional upside tied to upsell support and revenue growth




Why AdaptCFO


  • Fully remote team
  • High ownership role with direct impact on the business
  • Clear path to leadership as the company grows
  • Exposure to U.S.-based clients and finance operations
  • Fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment

title: Developer Salesforce
description:
Buscamos un Senior Salesforce Developer con sólido dominio del ecosistema Salesforce, especialmente Sales Cloud y Service Cloud, capaz de diseñar, implementar y optimizar soluciones robustas y escalables.

El rol requiere alto entendimiento funcional y técnico de Salesforce, sin necesidad de ser experto en todos los módulos, pero con la capacidad de adaptarse y aprender rápidamente nuevas nubes y componentes según las necesidades del negocio.


Responsabilidades Principales

• Desarrollar Apex Classes, Controllers y Triggers en Force.com para personalizar soluciones Salesforce según requerimientos funcionales y de negocio.

• Diseñar y construir Lightning Web Components (LWC), incluyendo CSS, configuración y despliegue en Lightning Record Pages.

• Configurar y optimizar funcionalidades en Sales Cloud y Service Cloud, asegurando soluciones eficientes para equipos comerciales y de atención al cliente.

• Implementar componentes de Vlocity / OmniStudio (FlexCards, OmniScripts, DataRaptors e Integration Procedures) para flujos guiados y experiencias dinámicas.

• Diseñar OmniScripts con lógica condicional para procesos de selección de productos y captura estructurada de información. • Desarrollar FlexCards en Financial Services Cloud (FSC) para visualización de información clave como préstamos, límites de crédito y recomendaciones.

• Construir DataRaptors e Integration Procedures para integraciones con APIs externas y sistemas internos.

• Desarrollar y mantener campañas multicanal en Salesforce Marketing Cloud, utilizando Journey Builder (Email, SMS, MobilePush y WhatsApp).

• Implementar AMPscript y SSJS para personalización dinámica de campañas, ofertas y recordatorios.


Skills Técnicos Requeridos (Core)

• Dominio sólido de Salesforce Sales Cloud y Service Cloud

• Salesforce Apex (nivel intermedio–avanzado)

• Lightning Web Components (LWC)

• Salesforce Configuration: o Flows o Record Pages o Objects o Permissions

• Integraciones con APIs REST / SOAP

• Comprensión funcional de procesos comerciales y de atención al cliente en Salesforce

• Inglés B2 indispensable (comunicación efectiva escrita y verbal)


Conocimientos Adicionales (No excluyentes)

No es requisito ser experto en todos los módulos, pero sí tener buen entendimiento general y disposición para aprender.


. ¿Qué ofrecemos ?

• Contrato modalidad Contractor

• Festivos oficiales de acuerdo al país de residencia

• Flexibilidad de horario

• Comunidades de practica

• Plan de Incentivos


Rate: Abiertos a negociar y escuchar propuestas


¿Por qué unirte?

Si buscas algo más que una oferta laboral, y quieres una experiencia profesional de alto impacto, con retos reales, crecimiento y exposición a proyectos complejos dentro del ecosistema Salesforce… ¡¡Postúlate ahora!!

title: Sr DevOps Engineer Azure (Remoto | PJ)
description:
100% Remote

USA EST Timezone

Contractor / PJ position



Role Overview

The goal is to shape the reliability and scalability of mission-critical platforms on Azure, Kubernetes , and modern DevOps toolchains. You will solve complex infrastructure challenges, automate end-to-end operations, and ensure systems operate with high availability, performance, and security.


What You Will Do

  • Design, build, and improve CI/CD pipelines for applications and infrastructure
  • Develop automation frameworks that reduce manual effort and increase consistency.
  • Configure and optimize cloud infrastructure to align with security, scalability, and performance best practices.
  • Collaborate with development teams to remove deployment blockers and improve delivery workflows.
  • Monitor reliability and performance, identify issues early, and implement data-driven improvements to increase uptime and efficiency.
  • Participate in on-call rotations and drive incident resolution with clear postmortems and preventive actions.
  • Maintain technical documentation for pipelines, configurations, and runbooks.
  • Perform readiness assessments and validation tests before production rollouts.
  • Implement Infrastructure as Code using Terraform and ARM templates with version control and reproducibility.
  • Troubleshoot complex deployment, provisioning, and performance issues across multi-cloud and containerized environments.


Minimum Qualifications

  • Proven track record in SRE or DevOps roles operating production systems
  • Hands-on experience running production workloads on Kubernetes in a cloud environment, including cluster design, autoscaling, upgrades, and network policies.
  • Proven CI/CD delivery using GitHub Actions or Jenkins , including promotion across environments, approvals, and rollback strategies.
  • Infrastructure as Code expertise with Terraform and ARM templates, including modules, remote state, workspaces, and policy enforcement.
  • Strong scripting in PowerShell, Bash, or Python for automation and diagnostics.
  • GitOps experience with Argo CD or Flux , managing multi-environment application delivery and drift remediation.
  • Containerization with Docker and Kubernetes , including health probes, PodDisruptionBudgets, resource quotas, HorizontalPodAutoscaler, and operators.
  • Networking fundamentals with cloud network security practices such as VNet design, NSGs, Private Link, and ingress controllers.
  • Working knowledge of cloud security and compliance, including least privilege, secrets management, audit trails, and control evidence.
  • Excellent written and spoken English .
  • Ability to collaborate across US time zone .


Preferred Qualifications

  • Microsoft Azure certification , such as Developer Associate, Administrator, or DevOps Engineer Expert
  • Observability using Application Insights, Elastic Stack (ELK), Grafana, and Prometheus for metrics, logs, and traces.
  • Experience with log aggregation and alerting at scale using Elastic and Prometheus.
  • Understanding of high availability, scalability, disaster recovery, and cost optimization strategies.
  • Experience managing Windows-based containerized applications .


Plus

  • Experience in Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or AWS

title: Especialista em vendas SaaS
description:

Especialista em vendas (SaaS)

  • Converter as oportunidades qualificadas (SQLs) geradas pela equipe de pré-vendas (SDRs) em novos negócios e receita para a empresa. A missão do Especialista de Vendas é conduzir todo o ciclo de vendas a partir da qualificação, desde a apresentação da solução até a negociação e assinatura do contrato, superando as metas de vendas e construindo relacionamentos de valor com os clientes;

  • Desenvolver e apresentar propostas comerciais personalizadas e de alto impacto;
  • Conduzir follow-ups estratégicos para avançar a oportunidade no funil de vendas;
  • Mapear e contornar objeções complexas, tanto técnicas quanto comerciais;
  • Conduzir negociações de preço, prazos e condições contratuais com tomadores de decisão;
  • Utilizar técnicas avançadas de fechamento para garantir a assinatura do contrato e a aquisição do novo cliente;
  •  Gerenciar o pipeline de oportunidades (SQLs), garantindo um forecast de vendas preciso e atualizado.• Manter todas as etapas da negociação e os próximos passos rigorosamente documentados no CRM.• Colaborar com outras áreas (jurídico, financeiro, implantação) para garantir uma transição suave do novo cliente;
  • Construir e manter relacionamentos de confiança com os principais stakeholders e tomadores de decisão nas contas-alvo;
  • Atuar como um consultor, ajudando o cliente a enxergar o valor e o ROI (Retorno sobre o Investimento) da solução.


O que buscamos

  • Ensino Superior completo em Administração, Economia, Marketing, Engenharia ou áreas correlatas;
  • Inglês intermediário;
  • Experiência em vendas B2B, preferencialmente em vendas complexas ou de soluções de tecnologia (SaaS);
  • Gestão de metas de vendas;
  • Habilidade em prospecção e fechamento;
  • Competências: resiliência, visão estratégica, e comunicação. Capacidade de gerenciar múltiplas negociações complexas simultaneamente, cumprimento de processos e negociação.
  • Domínio das metodologias de vendas consultivas (como SPIN Selling e The Challenger Sale) para diagnosticar problemas e conduzir negociações;
  • Conhecimento em retorno sobre o Investimento (ROI);
  • Conhecimento em CRM e LinkedIn Sales Navigator e gestão do pipeline.


O que oferecemos:

  • Atuação Home office;
  • Benefícios: R$ 460,00;
  • Remuneração composta por fixo R$ 4.000,00 (CLT) e comissão variável por metas e resultados.

title: Quality Specialist
description:
Job Title: Generative AI Associate – Portuguese

Location: Brazil – Remote work

Language: Portuguese

Time Commitment - 5-6 hours per day


About the role:

At Innodata, we’re working with the world’s largest technology companies on the next generation of generative AI and large language models (LLMs). We’re looking for smart, savvy, and creative Generative AI Associates to join our team.

We are building a team of evaluators to assess the quality of Large Language Model (LLM) outputs in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR). This role focuses on ensuring responses are not only linguistically accurate, but also culturally relevant and aligned with regional nuances across Brazil.

You will play a key role in improving how AI systems communicate with Brazilian users by identifying gaps in tone, cultural context, and localization.

What you’ll be doing:

  • Write and refine prompts in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR) to test model behavior across a variety of scenarios
  • Interact directly with the LLM in real time to evaluate responses and explore edge cases
  • Review and evaluate AI-generated responses in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Assess outputs for:
  • Cultural relevance and appropriateness
  • Local idioms, tone, and natural phrasing
  • Regional variations across Brazil
  • Accuracy and clarity of information
  • Compare multiple responses and determine which performs best based on defined criteria
  • Provide clear, structured feedback to improve model performance
  • Flag issues such as unnatural phrasing, cultural mismatches, or misleading content Follow detailed evaluation guidelines and maintain consistency across tasks
  • Collaborating closely with language specialists, team leads, and QA leads to produce the best possible work
  • Hit productivity targets for number of prompts written and average handling time per prompt

What we need you to bring:

  • Bachelor’s degree or above or associates and 1 year of relevant industry experience or high school degree and 2 years of relevant industry experience
  • Native fluency in Brazilian Portuguese (pt-BR)
  • Strong understanding of Brazilian culture, regional differences, and linguistic nuances
  • Excellent reading comprehension and attention to detail
  • Ability to apply guidelines consistently and make objective judgments
  • Comfort working with structured evaluation frameworks and annotation tools
  • Excellent writing skills (in Portuguese)
  • Strong understanding of grammar, syntax, and semantics
  • Ability to adopt different voices and points of view
  • Creative thinking
  • Strong attentive to detail
  • Well-honed internet research skills
  • Ability to embrace diverse teams
  • Ability to navigates ambiguity with grace
  • Adaptability to thrive in a dynamic environment, with the agility to adjust to evolving guidelines and requirements

We are looking for an experienced Customer Operations & Finance Support professional to join our team and play a key role in managing premium enterprise customer accounts within a structured ITIL‑based operations model.


This role combines customer service leadership, finance & accounting ownership, and IT service management , making it ideal for someone who enjoys working across functions, engaging with senior stakeholders, and driving operational excellence in a multinational environment.


Your role and responsabilities:


  • Create, update, and manage customer data within internal ITIL tools to support end‑to‑end service workflows
  • Own and manage the financial health of customer accounts , including:
  • Monthly Balance Sheet preparation & review
  • Account reconciliations
  • P&L analysis and variance explanations
  • Perform financial analysis and reporting to support business and management decisions
  • Lead customer onboarding and offboarding for SAP ECS accounts , coordinating with cross‑functional stakeholders
  • Work directly with Premium Customers , ensuring a high‑quality, reliable service experience
  • Monitor customer service metrics, analyze trends, and take proactive actions to improve delivery
  • Measure, track, and improve overall customer experience levels
  • Analyze support workflows and propose improvements for efficiency and effectiveness
  • Manage support operations in a 24x5 model , ensuring smooth workload handovers and SLA compliance
  • Develop, document, and maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs)
  • Support management with forecasting, budgeting , and performance tracking vs. plan
  • Lead and support customer service teams through transitions, service introductions, or operational changes
  • Collaborate closely with senior management to align customer service outcomes with company goals


✅ What You Bring


  • Experience working in an Operations Support model
  • Advanced English
  • Strong experience in frontline customer management , including executive‑level interactions
  • Proven experience managing Finance & Accounting aspects of customer accounts
  • Hands‑on experience with ITIL processes , including:
  • Incident Management
  • Service Request Management
  • Change Management
  • Excellent analytical and problem‑solving skills
  • High attention to detail and accuracy in financial data analysis and reporting
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team
  • Experience working in a multinational or cross‑cultural environment


Nice to Have


  • Project management experience in service transition and/or service introduction
  • Experience with common customer service and ITSM tools
  • Exposure to enterprise or SAP‑based customer environments


Please submit resumé in English

title: Data Analyst
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.


Monthly salary: $1,500 - $2,000 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented Data Analyst to join their team. This role will play a critical part in driving data-informed decision-making across their organization. The Data Analyst will be responsible for developing and maintaining business intelligence dashboards and structuring and evaluating holdout tests.


The ideal candidate has a strong analytical foundation, hands-on experience with BI tools, a solid understanding of experimentation methodologies (including incrementality and holdout testing), as well as strong communication skills to closely collaborate with executive-level stakeholders.


Essential Responsibilities:

  • Develop, maintain, and distribute automated reports and dashboards across key business functions, including marketing, inventory management, merchandising, and pricing.
  • Assess creative performance using Motion to identify trends in content, formats, or products to improve their marketing mix.
  • Design, analyze, and interpret A/B tests, ensuring statistical rigor and providing clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Partner with marketing and product teams to evaluate incremental lift and long-term impact using holdout and experimentation frameworks.
  • Monitor and evaluate business performance against established KPIs, identifying trends, risks, and growth opportunities.
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams—including marketing, product, finance, and sales—to understand data needs and proactively deliver insights that support business objectives.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of reporting, experimentation, and analytical best practices.


Qualifications & Skills:

  • 1-3 years of professional experience in a data analyst, business analyst, or similar analytical role.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with experience working with large and complex datasets.
  • Advanced proficiency in Excel (pivot tables, formulas, data modeling).
  • Hands-on experience with Business Intelligence tools such as Power BI, Tableau, or Looker.
  • Solid understanding of statistical methods, including A/B testing, holdout testing, and experimental design.
  • Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.
  • Experience in e-commerce, retail, or consumer brands is a plus


Work Schedule : US Pacific Standard Time


Benefits:

  • A fully remote position with a structured schedule that supports work-life balance.
  • The opportunity to join a fast-growing eCommerce brand setting new standards in digital marketing and customer acquisition.
  • Two weeks of paid vacation per year.
  • 10 paid days for local holidays.


*Please note our partner is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Pessoa Desenvolvedora Full Stack Web
description:
Venha integrar um time de excelência, somos a Eyemobile uma startup que nasceu para revolucionar o varejo! ✨

Você fará parte de um time que constrói soluções modernas utilizando React no front-end e Node.js no back-end, integrando serviços em nuvem AWS e garantindo qualidade em todo o ciclo de desenvolvimento.


No seu dia a dia estas serão suas responsabilidades:

  • Aplicar boas práticas de segurança nas entregas.


Para desempenhar estas atividades entendemos que você precisa ter:

  • Experiência comprovada em JavaScript/TypeScript . Conhecimento avançado em React e Node.js .
  • Vivência com frameworks back-end (Fastify, Express, NestJS, Koa.js ).
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (MySQL, MongoDB, Redis ).
  • Familiaridade com práticas de CI/CD e ferramentas como BitBucket/GitLab .
  • Experiência com AWS e seus principais serviços.
  • Domínio de Git para versionamento e colaboração.


Diferenciais técnicos:

  • Experiência em arquiteturas serverless.
  • Vivência em ambientes de alta disponibilidade e escalabilidade.
  • Vivência com integrações com sistemas externos (ex: adquirentes, ERPs, gateways de pagamento)
  • Conhecimento de estratégias de segurança e observabilidade em APIs REST (rate limiting, circuit breaker, tracing, etc.)
  • Participação em projetos com alto volume transacional e requisitos de alta disponibilidade


Stack e Ferramentas

  • Linguagem: JavaScript (ES6+) / TypeScript
  • Front-end: React (SPA, Hooks, Context API, boas práticas de componentização)
  • Runtime: Node.js
  • Frameworks: Fastfy, Express, NestJS, Koa.js
  • Banco de dados: MySQL, MongoDB, Redis
  • CI/CD: BitBucket, GitLab
  • Infraestrutura: AWS (Lambda, API Gateway, ECS, RDS, SQS, EventBridge, S3, CloudWatch, Cognito, etc.)
  • Monitoramento: CloudWatch, etc.

  • Boas Práticas: Clean Code, SOLID, testes automatizados, integração contínua e cultura DevOps


O que oferecemos

  • Atuação em produtos críticos com desafios reais de performance e escalabilidade

title: Senior Data Engineer – AWS
description:
Your connection with Aubay starts in the following lines:

Aubay Portugal is a French multinational company that has been operating in the country since 2007, with offices in Lisbon and Porto. We are a leading technology consultancy with a presence in seven European Union countries, specializing in the management, implementation, development and maintenance of information systems.

With more than 150 active partners, we operate in strategic sectors such as banking, insurance, automotive, aviation, telecommunications, services and energy, driving innovation and digital transformation.

Excellence, proximity and innovation are the pillars that distinguish us and enable us to support companies in building technological solutions that make a difference.


What are we looking for?

  • 5+ years as a Senior Data Engineer, with a strong focus on AWS
  • Extensive experience with Data Pipeline Development, Data Modeling, Data Quality Assurance, Troubleshooting, and System Optimization
  • Hands-on experience with Big Data Processing (e.g., Apache Spark) and Real-Time Data Streaming
  • Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code (IaC) tools, such as Terraform
  • Strong knowledge of SQL and various SQL/NoSQL data environments
  • Experience with Big Data ecosystem tools (e.g., Hadoop, Cassandra, Apache Hive)
  • Experience with orchestration tools like Airflow is a plus
  • Proficiency in Python and other programming languages
  • Fluency in English (B2+/C1)
  • Availability to work in a hybrid model (2–3 days per week) in Braga, Lisbon, or Porto
  • Project based in Portugal - Open to professionals with Portuguese nationality, dual nationality, valid work permit, candidates currently in the visa application process, or those interested in relocating to Portugal



What do we have to offer you?

  • Comprehensive health insurance, including dental coverage;
  • Feedback&Coffee – our integrated performance management system, with regular feedback sessions and a structured Career Progression Model;
  • Aubay Training Academy, designed for your development: technical and behavioural training (in-class and e-learning), Meet&Techs, Webinars, Mentoring and Technology Centers;
  • Events and team building activities that strengthen team spirit and promote closeness;
  • Digital platform for mental health and emotional well-being, with free psychology consultations, so you can take care of yourself at any time;
  • Health and well-being programme, with workshops and initiatives for our employees and other activities open to the community;
  • We grow with you and your family - we offer a Mini-Aubilous Kit when your children are born and annual support for school supplies, from pre-school to higher education;
  • Language platform, with conversation classes in 12 languages;
  • Working model: hybrid/remote based in Portugal/on-site.


What makes us different?

  • Our organisational culture is based on solid values: commitment, excellence, team spirit, well-being, happiness and empathy;
  • We value and recognise those who are part of our history, with referral awards and a special birthday gift;
  • We believe in authenticity: we don't have a dress code, because what matters is talent and attitude;
  • We promote closeness and an informal environment;
  • Here, you will grow in good company, because we believe that professional development also means sharing experiences and building relationships.


Your next adventure starts here!

If you can see yourself growing with us, take the first step and send your CV.

The future is waiting for you — and so are we!

Personal data sent through the present application will be kept by Aubay during the application procedure and will remain stored whilst updated (for two years period).

title: Technical Support Engineer (Infra Focused)
description:
Company & Product

Our client is a Business Intelligence platform enabling customers to connect multiple data sources (e.g., Excel, SQL) into a unified environment, build interactive dashboards, apply formulas, and customize via plugins, scripts, and embedding. The product supports both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Support is organized into 4 pods: Analytics, DevEx, Data, and Infra.


About Role and Team:

Our Technical Solutions team spans the globe and uses the SWARM model for our tools, processes, and organizationalstructure. This shift focuses on driving a collaborative, rewarding environment that measures value creation and team playing.Our team is aligned directly with our Product and Engineering teams through a robust Subject Matter Expert program. We are employing best-in-breed tools along with processes co-authored or directly influenced by our team. We believe in the power of great customer experience, and the happiest customers are made by having the happiest team helping them.


Responsibilities:

- You will handle customer questions and issues by combining business acumen with technical assessment skills. You will perform troubleshooting of issues both through the our UI and the terminal

- You will work closely with Senior team members to develop your skills and technical expertise within specific areas of the product, with ongoing opportunities to grow

- You will partner with Customer Success Managers, Technical Account Managers, and Product to recognize trends in customer feedback and translate customer needs into a better overall product.


Work Hours : This role is dedicated to supporting our APAC region. For colleagues based in Brazil, the standard working hours are 6:00 PM to 3:00 AM (BRT) to ensure seamless collaboration with our global teams and clients


Main Skills:

  • Proven experience in B2B customer support , supporting software platforms or technical products in a customer-facing environment
  • Strong proficiency in Linux/Unix environments , including CLI navigation, file management, and log analysis for troubleshooting
  • Solid understanding of networking fundamentals , including the OSI model and protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, and HTTP/HTTPS
  • Foundational knowledge of containerization and orchestration technologies (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Familiarity with cloud and infrastructure models , including Cloud, On-premise, and Hybrid environments
  • Understanding of ITIL principles and production service standards, including SLAs, SLOs, and SLIs
  • Strong communication skills , with the ability to clearly explain complex technical issues to stakeholders

Nice to have:

  • Hands-on experience with Kubernetes (deploying and managing resources)
  • Basic proficiency in scripting (e.g., Bash, Python)


Soft Skills and Competencies:

  • Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with a data-driven approach
  • High attention to detail with the ability to prioritize, multitask, and meet deadlines
  • Ability to work effectively both independently and as part of a team
  • Proactive attitude with a strong focus on customer support and service
  • Motivation to learn, grow, and contribute to a collaborative environment
  • Excellent English communication skills (written and spoken)
  • Strong customer empathy and ability to adapt communication style accordingly
  • Ability to set clear expectations and consistently meet agreed timelines

title: Consultor de Customer Success | Experiência & Adoção | IA
description:
Estamos construindo um novo braço de Inteligência Artificial em forte crescimento e buscamos uma pessoa de Customer Success para garantir que nossos clientes realmente extraiam valor do produto no dia a dia.

Essa posição é focada em experiência, adoção e comportamento de uso. Não envolve implementação ou desenvolvimento técnico.

Estamos falando de um produto que muda a forma como empresas operam, automatizam e tomam decisão. Nesse contexto, sucesso do cliente não é suporte. É impacto.

Essa pessoa vai acompanhar o uso real da ferramenta, entender comportamentos, identificar onde o cliente trava e atuar para destravar.

Vai ser ponte entre cliente e produto.

Vai transformar dúvida em clareza.

Vai transformar fricção em evolução.

Buscamos um(a) profissional de Customer Success com perfil analítico e consultivo, que entenda que sucesso do cliente está diretamente ligado à adoção, engajamento e geração de valor.

Essa pessoa será responsável por acompanhar a jornada dos clientes, apoiar dúvidas técnicas e funcionais e identificar oportunidades de melhoria na experiência.

O que buscamos?

  • Alguém que entenda Customer Success como geração de resultado, não apenas suporte

title: Full Stack Developer (Node/Vue)
description:
*Native/Bilingual English is required for this role (read/written/spoken)


Please upload your CV Resume in English.

﻿

Monthly salary: $3,500 - $4,500 USD


Along with our partner, we are seeking an experienced Software Developer to join their team, where youʼll play a critical role in developing and supporting a multi-domain SSR application that powers over 900 sites. This role is perfect for someone with a deep understanding of Vue.js, Node.js, Vue SSR, and MySQL, who thrives in a complex, multi-domain environment.


As a Software Developer, you will be instrumental in architecting and optimizing a large-scale, multi-domain server-side rendered (SSR) application. Your expertise will ensure their platform remains performant, resilient, and adaptable to the diverse requirements of hundreds of unique sites. Additionally, youʼll create simple analytics queries in MySQL to support data-driven decisions for their applicationʼs performance and user experience.


Responsibilities:

  • Develop and Support: Design, implement, and maintain a multi-domain SSR application that supports over 900 sites using Vue.js, Node.js, Vue SSR, and MySQL.
  • Scalable Solutions: Develop reusable and efficient components to standardize functionality while catering to domain-specific needs.
  • Analytics Queries: Write MySQL queries to gather simple analytics, providing insights into usage patterns, performance metrics, and other data points.
  • Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with their design and manager teams to improve sites/applications.


Requirements:

  • Experience: 4 + years of experience in full-stack development, with a strong background in SSR and multi-domain applications.
  • Technical Skills:

○ Vue.js: Deep expertise in Vue.js (Vue 2/Vue 3) and component-based architecture.

○ Node.js: Back-end skills with Node.js, ideally with SSR experience.

○ MySQL: Proficiency in MySQL for both application use and analytics queries.

○ Webpack: Proficiency in Webpack for bundling and optimizing large-scale applications.

○ HTML & CSS: Strong grasp of HTML, CSS.

  • Problem-Solving:  Exceptional debugging and problem-solving skills, especially in multi-domain contexts.
  • Scalability Focus:  Experience building scalable applications that can handle complex requirements across numerous domains.
  • Communication:  Strong communication skills and experience working in agile teams.


Nice-to-Haves:

  • Experience with TypeScript and Nest.js.
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines.


*Please note our client is only looking for full-time dedicated team members who are eager to fully integrate within their team.

title: Software Engineer C# Sênior
description:
Somos a startup que mais cresce na América Latina e estamos no caminho para conquistar o status de unicórnio ainda em 2025. Atuamos com soluções tecnológicas que simplificam e conectam pessoas, impactando positivamente a vida de milhares de usuários. Já contamos com mais de 100 mil veículos em circulação, presença em mais de 100 filiais no Brasil e no México.


Se você busca crescimento acelerado, desafios constantes e a chance de transformar o futuro da mobilidade na região, aqui é o lugar certo para você.



Responsabilidades


  • Atuar em um ambiente de alta performance, com entusiasmo por ver seus resultados impactando milhares de clientes diariamente;
  • Colaborar ativamente com o time, com boa comunicação, disposição para aprender e compartilhar conhecimento;
  • Demonstrar perfil analítico e proativo, com foco em melhoria contínua;
  • Garantir a qualidade das entregas, com testes automatizados e boas práticas de engenharia de software;
  • Trabalhar com metodologias ágeis, adaptando-se rapidamente a mudanças;
  • Ter senso de dono, com responsabilidade de ponta a ponta pelas aplicações;
  • Utilizar inteligência artificial para acelerar entregas e elevar a qualidade dos produtos;
  • Aplicar conceitos sólidos de orientação a objetos, design patterns e arquitetura escalável;
  • Atuar com práticas DevOps, incluindo manutenção e monitoramento de ambientes de produção.



Requisitos Obrigatórios


  • 8 a 10 anos de experiência com C# e .NET Framework/Core;
  • Forte atuação no desenvolvimento de APIs RESTful;
  • Experiência com bancos de dados relacionais e não relacionais (SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MongoDB);
  • Experiência com mensageria PUB/SUB (RabbitMQ, entre outros);

description:
