title: Web & Mobile App UI/UX Designer
description:
About Chop Dawg


Founded in 2009 and headquartered in Philadelphia, Chop Dawg builds custom mobile apps, web platforms, and AI products for partners worldwide. We've launched over 500 apps with a 92% partner retention rate, working with everyone from first-time founders to Fortune 500 companies, including NASA, The White House, Jefferson Health, Six Flags, Wawa, Hilton, the NFL, and the U.S. Navy. Our teams span across the United States, Brazil, and Pakistan.


We don't call our clients \"clients.\" We call them partners, because that's the relationship we build. We're not a vendor you hire and check in with at the end. We're in it with you from day one, and this role is at the heart of how our partners experience the products we create together.


The Role


You GOTTA love designing apps. Not just making screens look beautiful, but thinking deeply about how users interact with digital products, how they move through an experience, and how great design decisions lead to great outcomes.


As a Web & Mobile App UI/UX Designer at Chop Dawg, you'll be joining our growing Brazilian design team of 9 designers, working alongside 2 American designers, as part of an 11-person creative powerhouse. You'll work directly with our partners across the United States and beyond, translating their ideas into thoughtful, polished, and development-ready designs.


This is a full-time, 40-hour per week commitment. Our designers typically manage 2 to 3 active partner projects at any given time, so you need to be someone who thrives juggling multiple workstreams, staying organized, and delivering quality work across all of them without missing a beat.


Every project is different. Our partners span industries and stages, from first-time founders with a napkin sketch to established companies looking to build their next big product. What stays consistent is the standard: every product we design should be something our partners are proud to launch and their users love to use.


What You'll Do


  • Design mobile apps, web applications, marketing websites, and branding assets for partners across a wide range of industries
  • Manage your workload across 2 to 3 concurrent projects, keeping each one moving forward on schedule and at a high standard
  • Create user personas, site maps, wireframes, low-fidelity and high-fidelity designs, product flows, and documentation
  • Build and maintain component libraries that keep design systems consistent across projects
  • Develop non-functional prototypes to validate design direction before development begins
  • Design branding elements including app icons, logo designs, and Apple App Store and Google Play Store assets
  • Collaborate directly with partners via Zoom to present work, gather feedback, and refine direction
  • Work closely with project managers, developers, and fellow designers through Slack, Jira, and Confluence to keep projects moving
  • Participate in design reviews and iterate based on partner and team feedback
  • Leverage AI tools like Claude and Google Stitch to enhance your workflow and output quality


What We're Looking For


Required


  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken. This is non-negotiable. You will be communicating directly with American partners daily, and clear, professional English is essential.
  • Reliable, high-speed internet connection
  • Available Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating experience designing mobile apps, web applications, and branding
  • Proficiency with Figma as your primary design tool
  • Experience with user personas, site mapping, wireframing, high-fidelity design, product flows, non-functional prototyping, and component libraries
  • Comfortable managing multiple projects simultaneously in a fast-paced agency environment
  • Experience working directly with partners and teams based in the United States
  • Experience working in an agency setting, ideally serving American or European clientele
  • Proficiency with Slack and Zoom for daily communication and partner meetings
  • Available to start immediately or within the next few weeks


Nice to Have


  • Experience designing for wearable devices and tablets
  • Familiarity with Jira and Confluence
  • Experience leveraging AI-powered design and productivity tools such as Claude and Google Stitch
  • Previous project management experience
  • Background in branding including app icons, logo design, and app store asset creation


Compensation


Starting at $1,000 USD/month, scaling up to $4,500 USD/month as you grow into the role and take on expanded responsibilities.


Availability


Monday through Friday, 9:00 AM to 7:00 PM EST. This is a full-time, 40-hour per week position. Must be based in Brazil.


Reports To:  Design leadership and CEO/CTO


Why Chop Dawg


We don't chase volume. We invest in relationships. That's how we've maintained a 92% partner retention rate and built a portfolio that spans startups, government agencies, and some of the most recognized brands in the world. Our Brazilian design team is growing because the talent is exceptional, and we want you to be part of that growth story. You won't be designing in a silo. You'll be collaborating with a tight-knit, international team that genuinely cares about the work and the people we do it for.


If you take pride in your craft, love working on products that matter to real people, and want to be part of a team that treats design as the foundation of everything we build, we'd love to see your work.

Apply directly through this posting. Include a link to your portfolio. Tell us about your design experience, the types of products you've worked on, and what drew you to this role.

description:

title: Professor de francês
description:
Faça parte da comunidade de professores que está transformando o ensino de idiomas no Brasil!


Onde os influencers do Brasil fazem suas aulas particulares!


A Idioma Independente , referência em inovação no ensino de idiomas, está buscando pessoas proativas, com perfil proativo e fluência em um segundo idioma, que querem ter sucesso no âmbito profissional, para se credenciar como professores e fazer parte da nossa comunidade engajada.


Aqui, você não será apenas mais um perfil online: você será parte de uma rede colaborativa com mais de 400 professores e 4.000 alunos que vivenciam nossa metodologia transformadora hoje, além de mais de 1000 professores e 10.000 alunos que já fizeram parte desta história.


Nos últimos 12 meses tivemos mais de 22 mil alunos interessados em fazer aulas conosco. Professores novos têm lotado suas agendas em até 30 dias, quando são comprometidos, se comunicam de forma eficaz e tem agenda no horário da noite disponível.


*Esta não é uma vaga CLT*


O que oferecemos?



  • Capacitação intensiva para melhoria no ensino de aulas de acordo com a nossa metodologia inovadora
  • Acesso exclusivo a uma plataforma com mais de 400 vídeos de treinamento, baseada em uma metodologia que já entregou resultados incríveis, com vídeos totalmente atualizados .
  • Mentorias semanais com especialistas experientes, que já treinaram mais de 1500 profissionais.
  • Plataforma exclusiva para acompanhamento das aulas.
  • Participação no nosso processo de captação de alunos, com possibilidade de ganhos adicionais relevantes, bastando você se interessar.
  • Descontos exclusivos em cursos de idiomas e viagens com a nossa comunidade.
  • Possibilidade de desenvolvimento e mentoria para ser um empreendedor de sucesso (se você quiser).
  • Um banco de aulas com mais de 800 aulas para facilitar o seu processo de construção de aulas.
  • Certificações dos treinamentos feitos dentro da comunidade que garantem que você obterá mais resultados juntos aos seus alunos e que agregam na sua carreira como professor independente.


Como saber se você é a pessoa certa para fazer parte da maior comunidade de professores independentes do Brasil?


Se você tem grandes ambições para impactar a educação no Brasil, acredita que o ensino de idiomas precisa de inovação, quer otimizar sua agenda de aulas e, ainda, gostaria de crescer como empreendedor, este é o lugar certo para você.


Necessário:


  • Maior de 18 anos , fluente em Português e outro idioma.
  • Disponibilidade de ao menos 20 horas semanais para treinamentos, aulas e ações práticas Esta é uma necessidade para obter os maiores retornos que a comunidade pode te proporcionar.
  • Possibilidade de participar em capacitações durante a semana, no turno da manhã ou tarde.
  • Independência para executar atividades, espírito de colaboração e vontade de contribuir para uma comunidade.


O diferencial?


Aqui você é mais que um professor.


Você será parte de uma comunidade de professores no ensino de idiomas , onde o trabalho colaborativo é a base para alcançar resultados de mercado altamente competitivos.


Esta não é uma vaga CLT , mas sim uma oportunidade de empreender e ser dono do seu crescimento com total suporte e estrutura de uma empresa inovadora.


Você cria laços e relações de confiança com pessoas que realmente se esforçam para te ajudar no seu desenvolvimento, devido ao modelo de negócio inovador que proporciona relações colaborativas e efetivas.


Se você tem vontade de fazer diferente e de vivenciar algo novo na sua história profissional, a ii com certeza é o seu lugar.


Faça parte da mudança no ensino de idiomas. Junte-se à Idioma Independente e transforme sua carreira e a vida de milhares de alunos!


O que eu faço?


  • Recebo capacitação para dar a melhor aula experimental da sua vida
  • Recebo capacitação em nossa metodologia, aprendendo como transformar a vida de muitos alunos, entregando resultado para eles/as
  • Recebo treinamentos e capacitações recorrentes com mentores experientes e especializados
  • Organizo e escolho a minha agenda e os horários que gostaria de ter alunos/as
  • Preparo aulas para os meus alunos/as
  • Dou as aulas para os meus alunos/as


Se você quiser ir além, também será possível, basta você se engajar na comunidade e aprender mais sobre todas as áreas do seu negócio.


QUANTO EU RECEBO POR ISSO?

  • Se você for somente professor, se dedicando 40h na semana a aulas, você poderá receber até R$4.000,00 por mês.
  • Se você quiser aprender sobre diferentes áreas e se engajar na comunidade, você pode construir uma renda mensal de até R$6.000,00 por mês em aproximadamente 1 ano.
  • Se você realmente quiser crescer e se desenvolver, se dedicando de forma integral junto da comunidade é possível chegar até R$12.000,00 por mês em 2 anos.


Tudo isso só dependerá de você, se quiser aprender mais sobre as partes comerciais e sobre como se tornar um mentor/a de professores.


Seja diferente, seja independente

title: Mean Stack Developer
description:
MEAN Stack Developer


On a day-to-day basis you will be:

  • Understanding logical architectures for web applications using better practice design principles.
  • Leading the development of web applications with the support of a small development team (for lead roles).
  • Utilizing CI/CD workflows using build and release automation in Azure DevOps.
  • Application development based on screens, documented requirements, and user stories
  • Assisting with third level support by driving the resolution of application defects and supporting a response to major application incidents.
  • Coaching other developers and sharing your knowledge and expertise within the team.
  • Participating in firmwide software development forums and communities to share ideas and contribute to our body of knowledge.
  • Actively participating in daily team stand-ups, workshops, and online technical forums.




About you


Applicants must be able to demonstrate the following ke

y capabilities and behaviour:

  • Exceptional problem-solving and critical thinking skills, an analytical mindset and outstanding attention to detail.
  • Experience designing and developing javascript web applications using Node.Js, Angular 2+, CSS3, HTML5 and Javascript.
  • Experience developing middleware, integration and messaging systems using REST APIs and popular message bus platforms (e.g. RabbitMQ, Azure Service Bus).
  • Strong understanding of event-driven, asynchronous programming concepts and best practice application design principles.
  • Strong understanding of non-relational database design and querying by using MongoDB, Cassandra, Redis or other.
  • Understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment, ideally using Azure DevOps (formerly Visual Studio Team Services).
  • Ability to work efficiently with remote teams using collaboration technology.
  • Ability to identify issues and solve complex problems as part of a team.
  • Ability to lead small development teams and foster strong working relationships (only for leads).
  • Ability to remain calm when under pressure and meet demanding deadlines.
  • Good written and verbal communication skills.
  • A proactive approach to resolving problems.


Ideally, you will also have:

  • Knowledge of ORM/ODM like Sequelize and Mongoose.
  • Experience with microservices architectures and containerisation using Docker.
  • Experience designing, developing and automating unit tests.
  • Strong understanding of source code version control, including the use of Git repositories.
  • Experience working on projects that follow an Agile Scrum methodology.
  • Strong awareness of system development life cycles (SDLC).
  • Good understanding of relational databases such as MS SQL Server, Oracle, PostgreSQL or any other.

title: Credit Risk Analyst
description:
Credit Risk Analyst — Acquisition & Online Lending

Full-time Contractor (PJ) | 100% Remote | US Central Time hours


⚠️ This is NOT an FP&A, Treasury, or Controller role. If your background is financial planning, accounting, or back-book portfolio management, this role is not a match.


Our US fintech client — an online consumer lender — is looking for a Credit Risk Analyst who owns the front end of the credit funnel. This means acquisition-side risk: designing risk tiers, sequencing underwriting decisions, managing approval/decline trade-offs at the top of funnel, and building the logic that determines who gets credit and at what terms — before any loan hits the books.


If you have hands-on experience with risk tiers, underwriting decision paths, dynamic acquisition pricing, or rescue lane strategies at an online lender, BNPL provider, or fintech — this role is built for you.


What You'll Do

• Optimize risk tiers and underwriting sequences for online customer acquisition

• Analyze precision/recall trade-offs in credit decisioning models to balance approval volume and loss rates

• Support or develop dynamic acquisition pricing strategies tied to risk performance

• Design and refine multiple underwriting pathways (multi-path sequencing)

• Build and monitor rescue lane strategies to recover near-miss applicants

• Track and report on front-end risk KPIs: approval rate, take rate, early delinquency, cost per funded loan

• Work closely with data and product teams to improve decision engine logic


Requirements (Non Negotiable)

• 3+ years of experience in online consumer lending, BNPL, or a tangential fintech/e-commerce credit environment

• Hands-on acquisition/top-of-funnel risk experience: risk tier assessment, underwriting sequencing, or dynamic acquisition pricing

• Fluent English — interviews, daily standups, and all written communication are in English

• SQL proficiency — comfortable writing queries independently to analyze credit performance data

• Ability to work US Central Time hours (approx. 9am–6pm CT / 11am–8pm Brasília)


Nice to Have

• Experience with rescue lane management or near-miss recovery programs

• Background in fraud risk within the acquisition funnel

• Exposure to multi-path underwriting logic or decision engine configuration

• Portfolio monitoring and credit loss forecasting (post-acquisition)

• Experience at an e-commerce, marketplace lending, or embedded finance company


What We Offer

• PJ/contractor arrangement — compensation aligned with fintech market rates

• 100% remote — work from anywhere in Brazil

• US Central Time schedule — structured workday, no late nights

• Direct exposure to a fast-growing US online lending operation

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Our growing ecosystem includes innovative products like Weather Now, a sleek app that delivers real-time forecasts with clarity and ranks among the top three most-used weather apps in the U.S.; Check Heart Rate Now, a quick and easy wellness monitor; and Wave Browser, a powerful and secure way to search the web. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

  • Strong background in academic scheduling and operations
  • Strong digital literacy and comfort using educational platforms and IT systems
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to problem-solve and adapt in a fast-paced, remote working environment


Desirable:

  • Previous experience as a Director of Studies or in a similar academic leadership role
  • Experience managing remote teams and asynchronous workflows
  • Background in recruiting and managing academic staff


What We Offer

  • A senior leadership role in a dynamic, growing international education company
  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression

title: Full Stack Developer
description:
Company Description

TokenFlow is an onchain token clarity platform. A B2B product, giving protocols complete visibility of their token ecosystem, including: all holder addresses, all transactions and their types, market maker tracking and performance, DeFi positions, and much more.


We're a small, lean team with lots of experience in crypto and tokenomics. We've received funding, and we're looking for our first non-founder hire.



What You'll Do
  • Design and implement scalable backend services and APIs
  • Architect, deploy, and operate cloud-native systems on GCP, AWS, or Azure, optimized for performance, scalability, and reliability
  • Own DevOps workflows end-to-end — CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code (Terraform/Pulumi), container orchestration, and environment management
  • Build, operate, and optimize data ingestion and processing pipelines for high-volume, event-driven workloads
  • Integrate and manage RPC-based data sources, designing resilient systems for rate-limited, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data access
  • Design, query, and optimize relational databases, with a strong focus on data modeling, indexing, query performance, and schema evolution
  • Monitor and maintain system health — defining SLOs, setting up alerting, and diagnosing performance bottlenecks across services and databases
  • Apply security best practices across services — authentication, authorization, secrets management, input validation, and safe handling of sensitive data
  • Secure APIs and services against common vulnerabilities — injection, broken auth, and unauthorized access
  • Enforce HTTPS and encryption for data in transit and at rest, and apply least-privilege access across services and infrastructure
  • Run security checks in CI/CD pipelines, maintain audit logs for sensitive operations, and set up rate limiting to protect against abuse
  • Maintain a workflow, continuously identify risks, review access controls, patch vulnerabilities, and improve defenses as systems evolve
  • Integrate and secure crypto wallet flows in production — signing, transaction validation, and key management
  • Collaborate across product, data, and infrastructure to ship features end-to-end
  • Write clean, maintainable, well-tested, and well-documented code


Requirements
  • Previous experience in fullstack, backend-focused software engineering, security engineering, or crypto/web3 development
  • Strong experience building backend services and APIs
  • Solid understanding of relational databases, query optimization, and schema design for performance at scale
  • Experience with DevOps practices including CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure-as-code, and container orchestration (Docker, Kubernetes)
  • Familiarity with cloud security fundamentals — secrets management, IAM, network policies, and secure API design
  • Experience securing API routes and endpoints — proper auth middleware, route guards, role-based access control, and scoped permissions
  • Understanding of how to handle sensitive data — PII, tokens, credentials — including encryption at rest, masking in logs, and secure storage practices
  • Experience running and debugging production systems
  • Familiarity with modern frontend frameworks
  • Hands-on experience running and maintaining containerized workloads in cloud environments


    • Nice to Have

    • Experience hardening production systems, database access controls, audit logging, and vulnerability scanning in CI pipelines
    • Familiarity with the crypto industry, including core blockchain concepts and onchain data
    • Experience with data-focused platforms (e.g. Dune Analytics, The Graph) and production-grade RPC node integration and monitoring


    Salary: $36,000 - $42,000 USD

    Fully remote, with preference if based in Brazil.

description:

title: SAP MM Consultant
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced SAP WM/EWM professional with strong expertise in Supply Chain, Logistics Execution, and cross‑functional SAP environments. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in SAP implementations, international supply chain processes, and interface management across global teams.


SAP Functional Expertise

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience, with eight years working with SAP systems.
  • SAP WM / EWM expertise.
  • SAP LE (Logistics Execution).
  • Experience with IDocs, Interfaces, EDI, SAP PI.

  • Solid experience in systems analysis, solution design, and configuration.
  • Ability to identify functional gaps and collaborate with technical teams to develop functional specifications.

Process, Documentation & System Support

  • Documentation ownership: Requirements, Design Specs, Testing, QA.
  • Provide SAP technical support for enhancements, new processes, break‑fixes, and 3rd party interfaces.

  • Initial request assessment

  • Demonstrated understanding of standard SAP-delivered process logic and process flows.
  • Participate in project work management, work request planning, and schedule creation.
  • Occasional domestic and international travel required.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum 8 years of SAP experience.

  • Strong SAP LE, IDocs, EDI, and SAP PI experience.
  • Secondary skills: SAP GTS / Foreign Trade, functional ABAP familiarity.

title: Consultor de Investimentos
description:
Estamos formando algo maior e alguns poucos podem participar.


A Fortes Equities , uma casa independente de Wealth Management, Private Banking e Soluções Patrimoniais, está buscando consultores experientes com base ativa de clientes que desejam mais liberdade, menos estrutura engessada e um modelo meritocrático de remuneração .


Se você já construiu sua carteira, conhece o mercado, e está em busca de reduzir burocracias, ampliar seus ganhos e ter mais tempo para o que importa , essa é sua oportunidade de se conectar a uma plataforma sólida, respeitada e com entrega de excelência.


O que oferecemos:

  • Modelo de parceria (PJ) sem vínculo empregatício, com total liberdade geográfica e de agenda
  • Repasse competitivo acima da média de mercado , com foco em investimentos (AuA/AuC)
  • Backoffice institucional completo, para você focar no cliente
  • Acesso a plataforma multiproduto com integração a parceiros bancários
  • Suporte jurídico, compliance, atendimento e estrutura para Wealth e Private


Nosso modelo oferece repasse acima da média do setor , conforme o AuC trazido para a plataforma:

Nossa estrutura interna é composta por mesas dedicadas e licenças regulatórias que nos permitem originar, estruturar e distribuir produtos e serviços de forma independente e complementar aos serviços do Consultor de Valores Mobiliários.

  • Certificação CEA ou CGA
  • Atuação atual ou prévia em escritórios de agentes autônomos ou consultores credenciados
  • Perfil relacional, ético e orientado a resultados
  • Espírito empreendedor e desejo de crescer dentro de uma estrutura consolidada

title: Data Engineer
description:
This is a mid-level data engineer role, fully remote, PJ contract and salary range is 20-25/hr USD.


Required Skills & Experience


  • 3–5 years of experience in data engineering roles.
  • At least 2 years of hands-on experience with Azure Databricks and Apache Spark.

title: Desenvolvedor .Net
description:
Vaga: Desenvolvedor .NET Core


⸻


Sobre o Wite Group / WiteTec

O Wite Group, por meio da WiteTec, é uma empresa orientada à construção de produtos digitais com impacto real no negócio. Atuamos com alto nível de responsabilidade técnica, foco em eficiência operacional e compromisso com entrega consistente em ambiente de produção. Não somos uma empresa de experimentação superficial — valorizamos profissionais que assumem ownership, tomam decisões e sustentam sistemas críticos com qualidade e previsibilidade.


⸻


Sobre a posição

Buscamos um desenvolvedor .NET Core com forte capacidade de execução, que saiba transformar demandas em soluções funcionais, escaláveis e seguras. O profissional será responsável por atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento e manutenção de sistemas em produção, com autonomia para propor melhorias e responsabilidade sobre o que entrega.


Não buscamos apenas alguém que “sabe programar”, mas alguém que resolve problemas reais, entende impacto de negócio e entrega com consistência.


⸻


Responsabilidades

• Desenvolver, manter e evoluir aplicações utilizando .NET Core

• Trabalhar com APIs REST de forma estruturada e performática

• Garantir qualidade de código, legibilidade e manutenção a longo prazo

• Participar de decisões técnicas com foco em eficiência e escalabilidade

• Atuar na identificação e correção de problemas em ambiente produtivo

• Colaborar com outras áreas (produto, dados, operações) para entregar soluções completas

• Assumir responsabilidade direta por entregas, prazos e estabilidade do sistema


⸻


Requisitos técnicos (Hard Skills)

• Domínio prático de .NET Core e C#

• Experiência com desenvolvimento de APIs REST

• Conhecimento sólido em banco de dados (SQL Server ou similar)

• Entendimento de arquitetura de sistemas (camadas, separação de responsabilidades)

• Experiência com versionamento de código (Git)

• Capacidade de debugar, identificar e resolver problemas reais em produção

• Noções de performance, segurança e boas práticas de desenvolvimento


⸻


Competências comportamentais (Soft Skills)

• Alto senso de responsabilidade (não terceiriza problema)

• Capacidade de execução sem depender de microgerenciamento

• Pensamento crítico e orientação à solução

• Organização e clareza na comunicação

• Maturidade para lidar com pressão e priorização

• Proatividade para identificar melhorias e agir


⸻


Observação final

Buscamos um profissional com alto nível de execução, que entrega, sustenta e evolui sistemas com responsabilidade real. Aqui, resultado prático é mais importante do que discurso técnico.

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Own your future

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.


Must haves

  • 6+ years of experience automating the build, test, and deployment of applications.
  • 4+ years of experience with containerization and container orchestration technologies, specifically Docker and Kubernetes (EKS).
  • Proven experience with CI/CD** and IaC tools such as GitHub Actions and Terraform.
  • Experience with secrets management using HashiCorp Vault.
  • Experience with Kubernetes management tools like ArgoCD.
  • Production operations experience in support of applications and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with the Apache stack (Kafka, Flink, Iceberg) is a plus.
  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Competencies

  • Hands-on implementation and development with continuous integration, continuous deployment, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and advanced monitoring tools running on Amazon Web Services, and monitoring the performance and ensure stability.
  • The services you build will enable seamless deployment and management of cloud-based systems.
  • You will also design how features should be implemented and help determine the best architecture to use in each situation.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with an SRE mindset.

Key responsibilities

  • Write Terraform modules to build and manage Infrastructure as Code.
  • Architect and implement tooling for all aspects of CI/CD, including secrets management with HashiCorp Vault, particularly for EKS environments.
  • Engage with Engineering teams to support application deployments, CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, and migrations towards IaC.
  • Implement enhanced logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions, utilizing tools like Grafana.
  • Drive architecture discussions and design decisions with a focus on simplicity, maintainability, and reliability.
  • Manage Kubernetes deployments and configurations using ArgoCD.
  • Advocate for transparency and knowledge sharing across the organization through regular blogs, reveals, and pull requests.
  • Create clear, thorough documentation that sets up other teams for self-guided success.

title: Social Media AI Content Creator
description:
We are first and foremost a great team full of ambitious and proactive individuals whose goal is to become the best professionals they can be and make Digital Silk a globally renowned digital agency. Our quest for excellence has resulted in our company’s growth and continuous need for outstanding team members.


We’re looking for a hands-on Social Media AI Content Creator who can combine strong social instincts with modern AI-enabled workflows to produce high-performing content at scale.


This role blends creative execution and performance thinking . You’ll create and ship social content consistently, support paid social execution, and use analytics to improve what we publish. You’ll collaborate closely with our design, content, and marketing teams, and you’ll be comfortable presenting insights internally and externally.


Must be an expert in the following:


  • Create social content across formats: short-form video concepts, carousels, static posts, story/reel scripts, captions, hooks, and CTAs using AI Tools and working with designers and video editors.
  • Use AI tools to accelerate production while maintaining strong brand voice, originality, and quality (ideation → drafts → refinement → variations).
  • Build and maintain a content pipeline: monthly themes, weekly plans, daily execution, and rapid-turnaround content when needed.
  • Drive measurable results from the assets you create. Engagement for Organic posts and conversions of ad creatives.
  • Repurpose long-form assets (blogs, case studies, webinars, podcasts) into high-performing social content.
  • Execute and optimize organic social publishing for client accounts: planning, scheduling, community-minded posting, and iteration based on performance.
  • Ensure each account follows clear brand guidelines (tone, voice, visuals) and platform best practices.
  • Collaborate with design and content teams to brief assets, refine creative direction, and ensure deadlines are met.
  • Work with tools like n8n, Google Veo, Sora, and Runway (including others) to create high performing Social Media content for our clients.
  • Work with internal senior leadership & clients to enable AI-first content workflows
  • Turn content produced from AI into high-quality, client-ready deliverables


Digital Silk is built upon the principles of self-betterment, excellence, proactivity, and teamwork. If you share our passion and values, and want to be challenged and thrive in your career, then you will fit right in.


Digital Silk offers competitive salaries, yearly growth opportunities AND company shares for all team members.


This is for a full-time, remote-work-at-home position as our headquarters are in the US. We do require team members to work from 8am to 5pm EST (with breaks) as our clients are in the US.


What we offer at Digital Silk:


  • A work culture focused on mutual success and continuous growth
  • Competitive pay, salary growth, and bonuses
  • Equity ownership in our company – share in profit upon company sale!
  • Challenging projects and opportunity to work with great team members
  • Work-from-home opportunity
  • 4 weeks paid time off


Requirements & Responsibilities:


  • Create organic & paid social content calendars in coordination with the design team
  • Set up social media campaigns on various platforms and optimize performance
  • Work with the social media team, provide ongoing training, and team improvements
  • Perform channel audits
  • Develop comprehensive social media strategies
  • Assist in sales pitches and on client calls
  • Create and present monthly reports with KPI’s
  • Superb English speaking and copywriting skills
  • Driven to get results and grow with the agency


We are a growing digital agency and are seeking to make IMMEDIATE hires.


Recruitment steps:


  • Apply via LinkedIn
  • Receive a short questionnaire
  • Send back answers + CV
  • Have an interview with the Recruitment team
  • Receive a technical test
  • Have a technical interview with the Hiring Manager/s
  • Get feedback


We kindly ask for your CV and all correspondence to be in English.

title: Principal Data Engineer
description:
About The Product

At Boldin , we believe financial confidence should be accessible to everyone. Money decisions shape our lives, yet too often people are left without the clarity or tools they need to make informed choices. We exist to change that. Boldin is a comprehensive financial planning platform that helps people understand their financial picture, make smarter decisions with their money and time, and plan for the future with confidence.

With over $20M raised and strong momentum, Boldin is entering a pivotal phase of growth. This is an opportunity to join a mission-driven team and help shape the future.


About This Role

The Principal Data Engineer is a senior technical authority responsible for defining Boldin’s data architecture, setting long-term technical strategy, and tackling our most complex data engineering challenges. This role shapes company-wide data standards, and partners with executive and cross-functional leaders to ensure our data platform scales with the business.


Key Responsibilities:

  • Define and evolve long-term data architecture and vision
  • Design resilient and scalable data platform and pipelines
  • Set standards for data modeling, reliability, observability, and governance
  • Lead complex, high-risk technical initiatives and migrations
  • Influence tool selection, and technology adoption across the data stack
  • Elevate engineering excellence
  • Partner with leadership to align data strategy and business goals
  • Enable analytics, ML, and product use cases 1KPIS + Targets
  • Uptime: Consistently meets SLA for business-critical pipelines
  • Freshness: All Tier 1 datasets delivered within SLA
  • Delivery predictability: Majority of sprint commitments completed as planned
  • Cost optimization: Year-over-year efficiency improvement as data scales
  • Documentation: Full coverage for all production-grade assets


Qualifications

Technical Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 10+ years of experience in data engineering or related disciplines
  • Proficient in SQL, Python, or related languages
  • Cloud Platforms (AWS, GCP)
  • Strong experience with data warehouse, data lakes, and distributed systems
  • Strong experience with modern data stack (Athena, BigQuery, Glue, Spark, Dataproc, Kafka, Flink, dbt, Kestra, Fivetran or equivalent)
  • Proven ability to build and maintain production-grade ELT/ETL pipelines
  • Experience with workflow orchestration (e.g., Airflow, Dagster, Prefect, Cloud Composer)
  • Experience implementing data quality and observability frameworks
  • Performance and cost optimization in cloud warehouses
  • Good spoken English


Product & Business Partnership:

  • Experience supporting product analytics and experimentation
  • Ability to translate business requirements into scalable data models
  • Strong ownership and accountability for SLAs


Nice to Have:

  • Experience working with Kubernetes
  • Experience structuring data for ML or AI use cases
  • Familiarity with Amplitude or product event pipelines
  • Experience in a high-growth SaaS or fintech environment
  • Influencing technical direction without direct managerial authority


Benefits:

  • Collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Flex PTO for any reason, including sick days (no specified limits), flexible work schedule.
  • Personal laptop.
  • Health and wellness package.
  • Budget for English lessons.


Kindly submit your application and CV in English.

title: Senior .NET Developer
description:
We're hiring! We are looking for a Senior .NET Developer based in Brazil to join a product engineering team building the core of a modern, scalable SaaS platform.


This is a hands-on senior role for someone who enjoys solving complex backend challenges, designing clean architectures, and building systems that support multiple products and teams. You'll work on a platform with strong focus on microservices, multi-tenant architecture, cloud infrastructure, observability, and secure backend development .


We're looking for someone who is highly autonomous, communicates well in English, and is excited about using AI-assisted development tools as part of a modern engineering workflow.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services using C# and modern .NET
  • Develop and evolve REST APIs and microservices
  • Contribute to the architecture of a multi-tenant SaaS platform
  • Help shape domain models, technical patterns, and scalable backend foundations
  • Work on systems related to authentication, authorization, observability, and CI/CD
  • Build solutions designed for high throughput , async workloads, and performance
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to extend platform capabilities
  • Participate in technical discussions, architecture decisions, and implementation planning
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve speed, quality, and delivery


Requirements

  • Strong written and spoken English
  • CNPJ in Brazil + ability to issue monthly Nota Fiscal
  • 5-8 years of professional experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem
  • Proven experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs and microservices
  • Strong knowledge of Entity Framework Core , LINQ , and relational database design
  • Solid understanding of dependency injection , async/await , and backend performance optimization
  • Hands-on experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in real production systems
  • Strong understanding of CQRS , mediator patterns (such as MediatR ), and event-driven architecture
  • Experience designing modular, maintainable systems for complex business domains
  • Experience building systems that handle high-volume requests , async processing, and scalable workloads
  • Good understanding of large-file or document processing patterns such as streaming , buffering, and memory-efficient pipelines
  • Experience with message brokers such as Azure Service Bus , RabbitMQ , or similar
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure
  • Strong working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or enterprise-grade backend platforms
  • Understanding of JWT / OAuth2 , secure backend design, and secrets management
  • Experience with observability tools such as Grafana , Loki , or equivalent
  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot , Claude Code , or similar


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Temporal or workflow orchestration tools
  • Experience with OpenAI , Azure OpenAI , Anthropic , or LLM integrations
  • Experience with document-heavy, enterprise, or compliance-sensitive systems
  • Experience with distributed systems and event-driven platforms at scale


What We're Looking For

  • Strong ownership and accountability
  • Clear communication and ability to work directly with technical stakeholders
  • Comfort working independently in a remote environment
  • Someone who cares about software quality, reliability, and maintainability
  • A senior engineer who can combine hands-on execution with architectural thinking
  • Genuine interest in how AI is changing software development workflows

• Build APIs and integrations to connect external systems and implement business logic and flows.

• Create and maintain documentation for developed applications and processes.

title: Customer Success Pleno
description:
Sobre a Payfy

A Payfy é uma fintech B2B que está redefinindo como empresas operam financeiramente no Brasil. Com cartões corporativos e tecnologia integrada, eliminamos relatórios de despesas, reduzimos complexidade administrativa e simplificamos a contabilidade de empresas de médio e grande porte.

Temos uma cultura IA First de verdade — não como slogan, mas como jeito de trabalhar. Aqui, IA é ferramenta do dia a dia: quem entra precisa não só usar, mas saber usar com propósito.


O desafio

Você vai ser o ponto de contato estratégico dos nossos clientes — do onboarding ao crescimento contínuo. Sua missão é garantir que cada empresa da sua carteira use a plataforma de forma efetiva, identificando oportunidades de expansão e antecipando problemas antes que virem churns.

Essa não é uma posição para quem faz CS no piloto automático. É para quem usa IA para trabalhar mais rápido, se comunicar melhor e enxergar padrões antes que os dados gritem.


O que você vai fazer

  • Conduzir demonstrações e implantações de novos clientes, usando IA para personalizar apresentações e antecipar dúvidas com base no perfil de cada conta
  • Gerenciar carteira high touch com comunicação ativa e periódica, apoiada por automações e resumos gerados com IA
  • Mapear saúde dos clientes, identificar riscos de churn e oportunidades de expansão — usando dados e ferramentas de IA para acelerar análise
  • Registrar interações e manter CRM atualizado com agilidade, usando IA para estruturar notas e follow-ups



O que buscamos

  • Experiência em CS com foco em onboarding e carteiras high touch: sabe conduzir jornada do cliente do zero ao engajamento real
  • Uso de IA no trabalho: usa ferramentas como Claude, ChatGPT ou similares para escrever melhor, analisar mais rápido e automatizar etapas repetitivas. Não é IA por moda — é IA com propósito
  • Organização e agilidade: consegue gerenciar volume de clientes, demandas simultâneas e registros sem perder o fio da meada
  • Comunicação clara e direta: boa oratória, escrita objetiva e presença nas interações com o cliente
  • Senso de produto e negócio: entende o impacto do CS no resultado financeiro da empresa e do cliente



O que não buscamos

  • Quem faz CS só no relacionamento, sem interesse em dados, processos e melhoria contínua
  • Quem usa IA apenas para gerar textos genéricos, sem integrar ao processo real de trabalho
  • Perfis que precisam de muito contexto e direcionamento para tomar decisões simples



O que oferecemos

  • Contrato CLT — R$ 2.900 fixo + variável
  • Vale alimentação ou refeição — você escolhe
  • Assistência médica e odontológica 100% subsidiada pela empresa (após 3 meses)
  • Day off de aniversário
  • Wellhub + Conexa Saúde
  • Time enxuto, decisão rápida e impacto visível
  • Cultura IA First — você vai usar, evoluir e crescer junto com a tecnologia



Diversidade e Inclusão na Payfy

Você é livre para ser você. Valorizamos quem você quiser ser, independente de raça, cor, religião, identidade de gênero, nacionalidade, deficiência, orientação sexual, ascêndência ou idade.


Se você leu até aqui e se identificou, queremos te conhecer.

Mande sua candidatura com uma mensagem contando como você usa IA no seu trabalho hoje — isso importa mais do que você imagina.

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) PJ
description:
Qual será o seu papel?

  • Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas.
  • Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente.
  • Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes.
  • Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Domínio de Kubernetes: Experiência avançada em configuração de redes (CNI/Cilium), serviços (LoadBalancer, Ingress) e Service Mesh (Istio).
  • Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk).
  • Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD.
  • Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch).
  • Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts.


Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial):

  • Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure).
  • Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening) de imagens Docker.
  • Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura.
  • Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure)


Contratação: PJ.

title: Desenvolvedor(a) Back-end SR (.Net)
description:
Há 10 anos no mercado, a V8.Tech é uma empresa jovem, movida por tecnologia e inovação, que acelera a transformação digital. Ajudamos nossos clientes a revolucionarem seus negócios por meio da reestruturação e evolução, com foco na otimização de processos, tecnologia da informação, transformação digital e no crescimento em diversos setores.   • Experiência com APIs REST e múltiplos modelos de entrega de dados, como mensageria e data marts.

  • Sybase (Diferencial)
  • Capacidade de atuar em sistemas com alto volume de dados e transações.

  • Conhecimentos de Java e orientação a objetos.

These are hands-on engineering roles — you will be writing code, designing solutions, and shipping features across a large, mature codebase. We are not looking for administrators or declarative-only builders; we need engineers who think in code and architecture.

We're hiring across both UI/Frontend  and Backend/Platform  specializations, and you'll work on a production Experience Cloud site built with Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Bootstrap, supported by a robust backend of Apex services, integrations, and asynchronous processing.



What You'll Work On


Frontend / UI Engineers  will focus on:

  • Building and maintaining Lightning Web Components within an Experience Cloud site serving external users
  • Working with Bootstrap-based styling and responsive layouts alongside the LWC framework
  • Designing component architectures that are performant, accessible, and maintainable at scale
  • Integrating frontend components with Apex controllers, platform events, and real-time data flows

Backend / Platform Engineers  will focus on:

  • Designing and building Apex services, triggers, and automation across a complex data model
  • Implementing and maintaining asynchronous processing patterns including Queueable Apex, Batchable Apex, and Platform Events
  • Working with the Connect API and other Salesforce platform APIs
  • Building and supporting MuleSoft integrations for document processing and connectivity to external systems
  • Ensuring governor limit compliance, bulkification, and performance optimization across high-volume operations

All engineers  will contribute to code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.



Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline — we value a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, systems design, and software engineering principles
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience , with a meaningful portion spent writing code on the Salesforce platform (Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Visualforce)
  • Demonstrated experience building large-scale applications  — you've worked in codebases with significant complexity, not just small apps or proof-of-concept projects
  • Experience building cloud-native or cloud-hosted applications  — you understand multi-tenant architecture, API-driven design, and the tradeoffs of building on a managed platform
  • Proficiency with modern AI-assisted development tools  (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) — you actively use AI to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review, and you understand how to validate and guide AI-generated output effectively
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals : version control (Git), testing strategies, CI/CD, separation of concerns, and clean code practices



Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud  (Community Cloud) site development
  • Hands-on experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC)  in production
  • Experience with MuleSoft  (Anypoint Platform, API-led connectivity, CloudHub)
  • Familiarity with Platform Events  and event-driven architecture on Salesforce
  • Experience with Batchable and Queueable Apex  patterns for high-volume data processing
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce Connect API
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II  (valued but not required — we care more about what you can build than what you've passed)
  • Experience with Bootstrap  or similar CSS frameworks in the context of LWC development
  • Familiarity with document processing pipelines and integration patterns

title: Platform Engineer
description:
We're hiring! We are looking for a Platform Engineer based in Brazil to join a team responsible for building and maintaining the infrastructure that powers a growing ecosystem of legal technology products.


This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across cloud, automation, Kubernetes, GitOps, and observability, helping ensure that the platforms our development teams rely on are reliable, scalable, and secure.


You'll work across Microsoft Azure and on-premises datacenter environments , contributing to a modern hybrid infrastructure with strong focus on infrastructure-as-code, container orchestration, CI/CD, security, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.


We're looking for someone who is highly autonomous, communicates well in English, and is excited about using AI-assisted development tools as part of a modern infrastructure engineering workflow.


Responsibilities

  • Design, provision, and maintain infrastructure across Azure and on-premises environments
  • Manage and support Kubernetes clusters across hybrid environments
  • Build and extend infrastructure automation using Terraform and Ansible
  • Contribute to GitOps-based deployment and environment management workflows
  • Support observability platforms for logs, metrics, dashboards, and alerting
  • Collaborate with development teams to ensure infrastructure is secure, scalable, and aligned with product needs
  • Help maintain CI/CD workflows and improve delivery consistency
  • Contribute to platform reliability, security, and operational excellence
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented infrastructure code and technical documentation
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve speed, quality, and delivery


Requirements

  • Strong written and spoken English
  • CNPJ in Brazil + ability to issue monthly Nota Fiscal
  • 3-5 years of professional experience in Platform Engineering, DevOps, or Infrastructure Engineering
  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform
  • Practical experience with Kubernetes in both cloud and on-prem environments
  • Experience with GitOps tools such as ArgoCD or similar
  • Hands-on experience with Ansible for provisioning, automation, and configuration management
  • Good understanding of Azure Landing Zone concepts, including subscriptions, policy, networking, and governance
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar
  • Strong understanding of infrastructure-as-code principles, including state management, module design, and drift detection
  • Experience working with containerized workloads and deployment lifecycle management
  • Good understanding of hybrid infrastructure and networking patterns between on-prem and Azure
  • Working knowledge of Azure Active Directory B2C for identity and access management in multi-tenant environments
  • Familiarity with WAF configuration , security rule management , and least-privilege access patterns
  • Experience with secrets management and certificate handling
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools such as Grafana and Loki
  • Familiarity with metrics aggregation tools such as Grafana Mimir or similar
  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot , Claude Code , or similar
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate Terraform, Ansible, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational workflows


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure Policy , Blueprints , or Defender for Cloud
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd
  • Exposure to compliance-heavy environments such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA
  • Experience in legal tech or other enterprise / compliance-sensitive SaaS environments


What We're Looking For

  • Strong ownership and accountability
  • Clear communication and ability to work directly with technical stakeholders
  • Comfort working independently in a remote environment
  • Someone who cares about reliability, automation, and maintainability
  • An engineer who thinks in systems and wants to understand how all the pieces fit together
  • Genuine interest in how AI is changing infrastructure and software engineering workflows

Sobre a oportunidade

Você vai atuar diretamente no desenvolvimento de projetos, participando de diferentes etapas, da organização à execução, além de contribuir para a presença digital da Raya e dos clientes.

Buscamos alguém com vontade de aprender, crescer e construir junto, com atenção aos detalhes, sensibilidade estética e comprometimento com a qualidade das entregas.

title: Senior .NET Developer
description:
We're hiring! We are looking for a Senior .NET Developer based in Brazil to join a product engineering team building the core of a modern, scalable SaaS platform.


This is a hands-on senior role for someone who enjoys solving complex backend challenges, designing clean architectures, and building systems that support multiple products and teams. You'll work on a platform with strong focus on microservices, multi-tenant architecture, cloud infrastructure, observability, and secure backend development .


We're looking for someone who is highly autonomous, communicates well in English, and is excited about using AI-assisted development tools as part of a modern engineering workflow.


Responsibilities

  • Design, build, and maintain backend services using C# and modern .NET
  • Develop and evolve REST APIs and microservices
  • Contribute to the architecture of a multi-tenant SaaS platform
  • Help shape domain models, technical patterns, and scalable backend foundations
  • Work on systems related to authentication, authorization, observability, and CI/CD
  • Build solutions designed for high throughput , async workloads, and performance
  • Collaborate with engineering and product teams to extend platform capabilities
  • Participate in technical discussions, architecture decisions, and implementation planning
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-documented code
  • Use AI-assisted development tools to improve speed, quality, and delivery


Requirements

  • Strong written and spoken English
  • CNPJ in Brazil + ability to issue monthly Nota Fiscal
  • 5-8 years of professional experience with C# and the .NET ecosystem
  • Proven experience building and maintaining RESTful APIs and microservices
  • Strong knowledge of Entity Framework Core , LINQ , and relational database design
  • Solid understanding of dependency injection , async/await , and backend performance optimization
  • Hands-on experience with Domain-Driven Design (DDD) in real production systems
  • Strong understanding of CQRS , mediator patterns (such as MediatR ), and event-driven architecture
  • Experience designing modular, maintainable systems for complex business domains
  • Experience building systems that handle high-volume requests , async processing, and scalable workloads
  • Good understanding of large-file or document processing patterns such as streaming , buffering, and memory-efficient pipelines
  • Experience with message brokers such as Azure Service Bus , RabbitMQ , or similar
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure
  • Strong working knowledge of Docker and Kubernetes
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps and/or GitHub Actions
  • Experience with multi-tenant SaaS or enterprise-grade backend platforms
  • Understanding of JWT / OAuth2 , secure backend design, and secrets management
  • Experience with observability tools such as Grafana , Loki , or equivalent
  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot , Claude Code , or similar


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Temporal or workflow orchestration tools
  • Experience with OpenAI , Azure OpenAI , Anthropic , or LLM integrations
  • Experience with document-heavy, enterprise, or compliance-sensitive systems
  • Experience with distributed systems and event-driven platforms at scale


What We're Looking For

  • Strong ownership and accountability
  • Clear communication and ability to work directly with technical stakeholders
  • Comfort working independently in a remote environment
  • Someone who cares about software quality, reliability, and maintainability
  • A senior engineer who can combine hands-on execution with architectural thinking
  • Genuine interest in how AI is changing software development workflows

title: DevOps Engineer
description:
Own your future

Our culture isn’t something people join, it’s something they build and shape. We believe that every person deserves to be heard and empowered. If you’re on the fence about whether you’re a fit, we say go for it. Let’s build something great together.


Must haves

  • 6+ years of experience automating the build, test, and deployment of applications.
  • 4+ years of experience with containerization and container orchestration technologies, specifically Docker and Kubernetes (EKS).
  • Proven experience with CI/CD** and IaC tools such as GitHub Actions and Terraform.
  • Experience with secrets management using HashiCorp Vault.
  • Experience with Kubernetes management tools like ArgoCD.
  • Production operations experience in support of applications and cloud infrastructure.
  • Experience with the Apache stack (Kafka, Flink, Iceberg) is a plus.
  • B.S. or M.S. in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent experience.

Competencies

  • Hands-on implementation and development with continuous integration, continuous deployment, Infrastructure as Code (Terraform), and advanced monitoring tools running on Amazon Web Services, and monitoring the performance and ensure stability.
  • The services you build will enable seamless deployment and management of cloud-based systems.
  • You will also design how features should be implemented and help determine the best architecture to use in each situation.
  • Strong communication, collaboration, and problem-solving skills, with an SRE mindset.

Key responsibilities

  • Write Terraform modules to build and manage Infrastructure as Code.
  • Architect and implement tooling for all aspects of CI/CD, including secrets management with HashiCorp Vault, particularly for EKS environments.
  • Engage with Engineering teams to support application deployments, CI/CD pipelines using GitHub Actions, and migrations towards IaC.
  • Implement enhanced logging, monitoring, and alerting solutions, utilizing tools like Grafana.
  • Drive architecture discussions and design decisions with a focus on simplicity, maintainability, and reliability.
  • Manage Kubernetes deployments and configurations using ArgoCD.
  • Advocate for transparency and knowledge sharing across the organization through regular blogs, reveals, and pull requests.
  • Create clear, thorough documentation that sets up other teams for self-guided success.

title: Remote Business Analyst (German) - 54879
description:
About Turing:

Turing is one of the world’s fastest-growing AI companies accelerating the advancement and deployment of powerful AI systems.

Turing helps customers in two ways: Working with the world’s leading AI labs to advance frontier model capabilities in thinking, reasoning, coding, agentic behavior, multimodality, multilinguality, STEM and frontier knowledge; and leveraging that work to build real-world AI systems that solve mission-critical priorities for companies.


Role Overview:

We are looking for candidates with strong analytical and English comprehension skills. The ideal candidate should have the ability to read, summarize, and break down large content into smaller logical blocks, conduct research online, validate claims made in the content through online research, and work with the LLM (Large Language Models) to solve puzzles!

Your role is critical in helping fine-tune and improve large language models (like gpt), and will make you an expert on how to leverage AI to be a better analyst. This is your chance to future-proof your career in an AI-first world!


What does day-to-day look like:

You would spend time answering a variety of interesting analytical questions and creating scenarios that can train the LLM models to get better. Here are a couple of examples which models might get wrong and you would have to give the correct answer and explanation to enable the models to learn:

  • Based on a given distribution of sales by month across locations, could you analyze which location has grown the most? (Hint: what time period should we look at? should we account for sudden variability at the beginning?)
  • In a small town, there are four distinct neighborhoods: Oak, Pine, Maple, and Elm. A postman is assigned to deliver mail and can only deliver to two neighborhoods in one day, with certain rules (e.g. Oak is always visited before Pine). If he delivers to Oak and Elm on the first day, which neighborhoods does the carrier deliver to on the second day? Note: No other prior specialized domain experience is needed.


Requirements:

  • Multilingual capabilities are mandatory. (English and German)
  • Analytical Skills : Good research and analytical skills
  • Feedback Skills : Ability to provide constructive feedback and detailed annotations.
  • Creative Thinking : Creative and lateral thinking abilities.
  • Communication : Excellent communication and collaboration skills.
  • Independence : Self-motivated and able to work independently in a remote setting.
  • Commitment : Ability to commit to 40 hours per week for the contract duration overlapping US hours.
  • Technical Setup : Desktop/Laptop set up with a good internet connection.


Preferred Qualifications:

  • Bachelors degree or undergraduate in Engineering, Literature, Journalism, Communications, Arts, Statistics, or a related field. We are open to candidates who do not have a Bachelor's degree but have experience in the area.
  • Experience writing professionally (business analysts, research analyst, copywriter, journalist, technical writer, editor, translator, etc.)
  • Understanding of Excel and Google Suite.
  • Proficiency in Data interpretation, Logical reasoning and Basic arithmetic is highly desirable.


Perks of Freelancing With Turing:

  • Work in a fully remote environment.
  • Opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with leading LLM companies.
  • Potential for contract extension based on performance and project needs.


Offer Details:

  • Engagement type : Contractor assignment/freelancer (no medical/paid leave)
  • Commitments Required : Availability of up to 40 hours/week is preferred. This role will require some overlap with UTC-8:00 (2-5 hrs/day) America/Los_Angeles

title: Senior DevOps Engineer (Kubernetes & Cloud Infrastructure) PJ
description:
Qual será o seu papel?

  • Administração de Ambientes Híbridos: Gerenciar e implantar clusters Kubernetes tanto em ambientes On-Premises (usando kubeadm) quanto em nuvens públicas.
  • Gestão de Infraestrutura como Código (IaC): Provisionar e manter recursos de infraestrutura utilizando Terraform e Ansible, garantindo a escalabilidade do ambiente.
  • Otimização e Segurança de Containers: Criar e otimizar imagens Docker, além de gerenciar políticas de segurança, RBAC, quotas e namespaces no ecossistema Kubernetes.
  • Sustentação e Troubleshooting: Diagnosticar e resolver problemas complexos em pods, nós e serviços, utilizando ferramentas nativas e CLI de nuvem.
  • Monitoramento e Observabilidade: Implementar e analisar métricas e logs para garantir a saúde dos clusters e identificar gargalos de performance (CPU, memória, IOPS) de forma proativa.


Esperamos que você tenha:

  • Domínio de Kubernetes: Experiência avançada em configuração de redes (CNI/Cilium), serviços (LoadBalancer, Ingress) e Service Mesh (Istio).
  • Experiência com Armazenamento: Sólido conhecimento em PVs, PVCs e provisionadores de storage (Ceph, NFS ou nativos de nuvem como EBS/Azure Disk).
  • Fluência em Automação e CI/CD: Experiência prática na construção de pipelines e integração de automações com GitLab CI/CD e ArgoCD.
  • Conhecimento em Observabilidade: Experiência técnica com a stack Prometheus, Grafana e Alertmanager, além de gestão de logs (Fluentd, Loki, Elasticsearch).
  • Habilidade com IaC e Helm: Proficiência em Terraform, Ansible e no empacotamento/deploy de aplicações via Helm Charts.


Vamos ficar felizes se você tiver (seu diferencial):

  • Multicloud: Vivência em múltiplos provedores de nuvem (GCP, OCI, AWS, Azure).
  • Foco em Segurança: Experiência avançada na implementação de políticas de segurança de rede e endurecimento (hardening) de imagens Docker.
  • Mentalidade Proativa: Capacidade comprovada de antecipar incidentes graves através da análise técnica de recursos de infraestrutura.
  • Certificações nos provedores de Cloud (OCI, AWS, GCP, Azure)


Contratação: PJ.

title: Senior Salesforce Developer
description:
Senior Salesforce Developer

Brazil


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary

We are seeking an experienced Senior Salesforce Developer with Data Cloud experience to support a strategic initiative focused on reducing customer churn by integrating and enriching customer data across multiple platforms. This role will work closely with the Salesforce Architect, data engineering teams, and cross-functional partners to ingest, unify, and expose data within Salesforce CRM and Salesforce Data 360 (Data Cloud).

Responsibilities and Duties

  • Lead end-to-end ingestion and mapping of customer data from Salesforce CRM, Siebel, Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, and churn model outputs into Salesforce Data 360;
  • Design, build, and maintain identity and account unification rules to produce accurate customer matching and golden records;
  • Create scalable, repeatable pipelines for ingestion, transformation, mapping, and controlled promotion across environments (including Data 360 data kits);
  • Enrich Salesforce CRM records with Data 360 attributes and analytics/model insights (e.g., churn) using related lists, dynamic related lists, and custom UI components;
  • Support CRM data strategy during the Siebel-to-Salesforce migration, prioritizing Salesforce CRM as the system of engagement as adoption increases;
  • Develop and support APIs and integration services for secure internal consumption of Data 360 and CRM data; partner with architecture/engineering on integration patterns and implement ETL when native connectors don’t meet requirements;
  • Monitor and optimize Data 360 credit consumption to balance cost, performance, and SLAs;
  • Enable business teams to use enriched customer data for segmentation, activation, and analytics use cases;
  • Document processes, standards, and runbooks; contribute to shared enablement resources to drive adoption and operational continuity.

Essential Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce development;
  • Strong proficiency in: Apex, SOQL/SOSL, Lightning Web Components (LWC), Salesforce core data model, Salesforce APIs (REST/SOAP/Bulk), and integration design patterns;
  • Hands-on experience with Data ingestion and harmonization, Identity resolution and unification rules, Data kits and environment promotion, Large-scale data processing;
  • Experience connecting Salesforce Data Cloud/Data 360 to external systems (Azure/Microsoft Fabric, Oracle, Siebel, or similar), including when to use native connectors vs. custom integrations;
  • Experience with ETL processes and/or tools (e.g., Informatica, MuleSoft, Talend, Databricks);
  • Experience working in Agile/Scrum teams;
  • Strong technical communication skills, able to translate complex concepts for architects, engineers, business users, and leadership;
  • Advanced English to be in contact with customer representative on a daily basis.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud, especially data activation and segmentation;
  • Experience with Siebel CRM integration and/or data migration;
  • Knowledge of telecom customer data, churn analytics, or Customer 360 implementations;
  • Familiarity with Azure data engineering and Microsoft Fabric connector limitations;
  • Understanding of scalable deployment pipelines and DevOps tooling (Git, CI/CD).

title: Platform Engineer
description:

This is a hands-on role for someone who enjoys working across cloud, automation, Kubernetes, GitOps, and observability, helping ensure that the platforms our development teams rely on are reliable, scalable, and secure.


You'll work across Microsoft Azure and on-premises datacenter environments , contributing to a modern hybrid infrastructure with strong focus on infrastructure-as-code, container orchestration, CI/CD, security, and AI-assisted engineering workflows.

  • CNPJ in Brazil + ability to issue monthly Nota Fiscal

  • Strong hands-on experience with Terraform
  • Practical experience with Kubernetes in both cloud and on-prem environments

  • Hands-on experience with Ansible for provisioning, automation, and configuration management
  • Good understanding of Azure Landing Zone concepts, including subscriptions, policy, networking, and governance
  • Experience with CI/CD pipelines using Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, or similar

  • Familiarity with WAF configuration , security rule management , and least-privilege access patterns
  • Experience with secrets management and certificate handling
  • Hands-on experience with observability tools such as Grafana and Loki
  • Familiarity with metrics aggregation tools such as Grafana Mimir or similar
  • Active use of AI-assisted development tools such as GitHub Copilot , Claude Code , or similar
  • Experience using AI tools to accelerate Terraform, Ansible, troubleshooting, documentation, and operational workflows


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Azure Policy , Blueprints , or Defender for Cloud
  • Familiarity with service mesh technologies such as Istio or Linkerd
  • Exposure to compliance-heavy environments such as SOC 2, ISO 27001, or HIPAA
  • Experience in legal tech or other enterprise / compliance-sensitive SaaS environments


What We're Looking For

  • Strong ownership and accountability
  • Clear communication and ability to work directly with technical stakeholders
  • Comfort working independently in a remote environment
  • Someone who cares about reliability, automation, and maintainability
  • An engineer who thinks in systems and wants to understand how all the pieces fit together
  • Genuine interest in how AI is changing infrastructure and software engineering workflows

Brazil
