Job Summary


We are seeking a Senior Airtable Engineer with a proven track record in designing, architecting, and scaling mission-critical business systems built on Airtable. This is a hands-on technical role focused on building and maintaining robust, secure, and scalable Airtable-based operational platforms that power loan origination, underwriting, servicing, and internal workflows. The ideal candidate combines strong Airtable architecture expertise with automation, API integrations, third- party software integrations, data modeling, and process design skills, and can collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into elegant, efficient, scalable systems.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Design, architect, and maintain scalable Airtable bases and data models supporting loan origination, underwriting, servicing, capital markets, and operations;
  • Build advanced Airtable automations, scripts, and integrations using Airtable Scripting, JavaScript, and APIs;
  • Develop and maintain integrations between Airtable and third-party systems (e.g., CRM, loan management systems, document management platforms, accounting systems, and data warehouses);
  • Propose and deploy best-in-class third-party software integrations to support required business workflows and technical programming that are limited using native Airtable functionality exclusively
  • Implement data governance standards including permissions, access control, field-level security, naming conventions, and documentation;
  • Optimize Airtable performance, scalability, and reliability for high-volume transactional workflows;
  • Collaborate closely with Operations, Capital Markets, Finance, Data & Quality, and Engineering teams to gather requirements and implement scalable solutions;
  • Support system monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing enhancements.

Essential Skills


  • Experience designing and implementing complex Airtable architectures in production environments;
  • Deep expertise in data modeling and relational database design, automations and scripting using JavaScript, Interfaces and advanced workflow design, and permissions, governance, and enterprise-level structure;
  • Strong understanding of API integrations (RESTful APIs, webhooks, middleware such as Zapier and Make);
  • Proficiency in JavaScript for automation and integration scripting;
  • Experience integrating Airtable with external systems such as CRM platforms, loan management systems, accounting software, or document storage systems.

Highly Desirable Skills

  • Experience with Salesforce CRM and integration;

title: Full Stack Engineer
description:
This is a fully remote position, PJ model and pay range is 20-27/hr USD.


Overview

An Insight Global client is looking for a Full Stack Developer with a strong front-end focus to support and enhance enterprise web applications. This role will focus heavily on building modern, secure, and scalable user interfaces using React and Angular while collaborating with backend services built in C#/.NET on Azure. The ideal candidate is comfortable working in large, enterprise environments and has a solid understanding of web security concepts.


Responsibilities

  • Design, develop, and maintain front-end applications using React and Angular in an enterprise environment
  • Collaborate with backend developers to integrate C#/.NET APIs and services
  • Build and consume RESTful APIs and work with cloud-hosted data sources

  • Hands-on experience with React and Angular (enterprise-scale applications)
  • Experience developing backend services using C#/.NET
  • Cloud experience with Microsoft Azure
  • Experience working with Cosmos DB and/or MongoDB
  • Familiarity with Okta (or similar identity/security platforms)
  • Solid understanding of web security fundamentals , including:
  • ID tokens vs. access tokens
  • Token contents and claims
  • Token validation and secure handling
  • Experience building and consuming REST APIs
  • Strong JavaScript/TypeScript fundamentals


Plusses

  • Experience supporting large, complex, enterprise applications
  • Prior experience in oil & gas, energy, or industrial environments
  • Exposure to microservices or distributed systems
  • Experience with Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines
  • Strong communication skills and ability to work cross-functionally

title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are seeking an experienced Senior C# Developer to join a collaborative engineering team focused on enhancing Portfolio Management capabilities.


This role will partner closely with engineering, trading, risk, and operations teams to design and deliver scalable, high-performance solutions that improve portfolio transparency, accuracy, and operational efficiency across the firm. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in C#/.NET with a deep understanding of portfolio and position management concepts, and an interest in modern development practices including AI-enabled engineering and specification-driven development.


Responsibilities:

- Portfolio Management Enhancement

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve and extend portfolio management capabilities
  • Enhance portfolio aggregation, exposure calculation, and P&L reporting functionality
  • Improve intraday and end-of-day position workflows and controls
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives modernizing portfolio and position infrastructure


- Core Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services in C# / .NET
  • Contribute to the evolution of the Position Service architecture
  • Develop and enhance functionality within the Portfolio Management platform
  • Build scalable, resilient microservices supporting portfolio and order management workflows
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices


- AI & Intelligent Systems

  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI/ML and automation to enhance portfolio analytics, reconciliation, monitoring, and operational workflows
  • Collaborate on integrating AI-driven tools into the development lifecycle (e.g., intelligent code generation, review, testing, and documentation)
  • Contribute to the design of systems that enable advanced analytics and data-driven insights


- Specification-Driven Development


  • Promote and apply specification-driven development practices, including clear technical design documents and formalized functional requirements
  • Translate business requirements into precise system specifications prior to implementation
  • Ensure alignment between architecture, documentation, and delivered functionality
  • Improve development velocity and quality through stronger upfront design and validation processes


- System Design & Optimization


  • Improve system performance, scalability, and reliability
  • Optimize data processing pipelines and database interactions
  • Design and maintain robust APIs for internal consumers
  • Support both real-time and batch processing requirements


- Collaboration & Leadership


  • Work closely with portfolio managers, traders, risk, and operations teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Collaborate within the engineering team to drive architectural improvements
  • Participate in code reviews and mentor junior developers
  • Promote best practices in testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong expertise in C# and .NET (Core/Framework).
  • Experience building distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.
  • Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.
  • Strong SQL and database design experience.
  • Experience with messaging systems and asynchronous programming.
  • Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.
  • Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, and cost optimization
  • Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong team player.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.


English: C1 Advanced

title: Especialista de Infraestrutura I
description:
Quais são os desafios da área e do cargo:

Esta pessoa terá como objetivo atuar de forma alinhada à visão estratégica de Negócios do Grupo Fleury, contribuindo para a construção de um ecossistema de Saúde integrado, preventivo e híbrido, tendo como principal foco o cuidado com as pessoas.


Estar a frente dos principais projetos de evolução de ambiente, participar de reuniões de alinhamento e novas arquiteturas de soluções de virtualização e backup. Capacitar os analistas mais Juniores nas ferramentas e produtos do ambiente.


Se você tem interesse em fazer parte desse propósito e deseja estar sempre um passo a frente do mercado, vem com a gente!


Sobre a área:

Area responsável por sustentar e evoluir as soluções de backup e VMWare do Grupo mantendo o ambiente sempre Up to Date. E em conjunto com os parceiros cuidar da disponibilidade e performance do ambiente garantindo a estabilidade e escalabilidade do ambiente


Principais atividades:


  • Acompanhamento de indicadores de performance e erros do ambiente
  • Execução de Mudanças de evolução e manutenção do ambiente.
  • Atuação em warrooms ajudando na análise e resolução de problemas
  • Abertura de chamados com parceiros e fornecedores de produto
  • Desenho de processos de manutenção de ambiente para que parceiros ou outras áreas cuidem da operação Construção de códigos, scripsts e bats para automação de atividades e também de melhoria de monitoramento ou auto recuperação do ambiente


Buscamos alguém que apresente:


• Atuação em modelo home office, com disponibilidade para viagens esporádicas quando necessário (custos pagos pela empresa). Residir em São Paulo é um diferencial, devido ao acesso facilitado à Microsoft para eventuais treinamentos.

• Necessária vivência com Cloud, preferencialmente em Azure ou AWS. Conhecimentos em SRE, DevOps e certificações em Cloud (Azure, AWS, GCP ou OCI) serão considerados diferenciais.

• Sólida experiência com sistemas operacionais de servidores (Windows Server e Linux).

• Vivência com softwares de virtualização, preferencialmente VMware.

• Conhecimentos em tecnologias Microsoft, como Clusters, Active Directory (AD), DNS, GPO e DFS.

• Experiência com ferramentas de monitoramento de infraestrutura, como Nagios, Zabbix ou Prometheus.

• Habilidades em troubleshooting de ambientes de alta disponibilidade.

• Conhecimento

• Experiência com ambientes Citrix (implementação, manutenção e troubleshooting).

• Conhecimentos em monitoramento de ambientes e automação.

• Formação em cursos voltados à área de Tecnologia.


Antes da inscrição na vaga, é importante verificar se você atende aos requisitos e se conecta com nosso propósito.


Nossa essência inspira o dia a dia, por isso, buscamos pessoas apaixonadas pelo que fazem, e que:


• Estimulem um ambiente de troca de conhecimentos, compartilhando experiências, possibilitando a interdependência entre os times;

• Estejam em constante movimento, investindo em autodesenvolvimento e atuando como facilitadora no desenvolvimento das outras pessoas;

• Busquem consciência social de diversidade e inclusão, cooperando com a construção de um ambiente colaborativo;

• Identifiquem e antecipem as necessidades dos clientes, agindo prontamente para encontrar soluções adequadas e personalizadas;

• Planejem e executem o trabalho com excelência a fim de atingir os resultados esperados, com a visão de inovação e agilidade;

• Gerem e implementem novas ideias, buscando constantemente por melhorias para a experimentação de novas abordagens e a adaptação às mudanças do mercado.


Informações da vaga:

Modelo de Trabalho (Home Office)

Carga Horária: 220h

Escala: Segunda á sexta - feira

Horário de Trabalho: 08h00 ás 17h48


Cuidamos de você em cada etapa da sua jornada!


Saúde e Bem-estar:

• Assistência médica e odontológica para você e sua família;

• Ambulatório com clínica médica ou atendimento por telemedicina;

• Linhas de cuidado especializadas: gestantes, adoção, obesidade, oncologia, entre outras;

• Acesso à plataforma OrienteMe para sessões de terapia e orientação nutricional;

• Licença maternidade e paternidade estendidas;

• Acesso ao Wellhub para práticas esportivas e qualidade de vida.


Proteção e estabilidade:

• Previdência privada;

• Participação nos lucros;

• Seguro de vida.


Facilidades para o dia a dia:

• Vale-Alimentação;

• Vale-Refeição;

• Vale-Transporte;

• Auxílio-Creche;

• Clube de Descontos com lojas, farmácias, viagem, beleza, cultura, lazer, entre outros serviços.


Desenvolvimento e educação:

• Plataforma de ensino;

• Parcerias educacionais com descontos em cursos e instituições.


Aqui, o cuidado vai além dos benefícios — ele está presente em cada momento da sua trajetória.


Promovemos uma cultura inclusiva, focada na equidade e na valorização das diferenças. Nossas vagas são abertas para todos os públicos e, simbolizando a nossa intencionalidade, oferecemos oportunidades afirmativas.


Nosso compromisso vai além do cumprimento das legislações que incentivam a diversidade e inclusão. Trabalhamos ativamente para ampliar a representatividade de nossas pessoas, pensando em raça, etnia, gênero, gerações, pessoas com deficiência e LGBTQIAPN+ em nosso time, além de fortalecer a representatividade de mulheres negras, indígenas, chefes de família.

Ajudamos nossos clientes a revolucionarem seus negócios por meio da reestruturação e evolução, com foco na otimização de processos, tecnologia da informação, transformação digital e no crescimento em diversos setores. description:

Em busca de uma carreira em uma empresa que valoriza a flexibilidade, desenvolvimento pessoal e sucesso da equipe? Com 30 anos de experiência e reconhecidos pelo GPTW pelo quinto ano consecutivo, estamos em busca de talentos para se juntarem a nós como Arquiteto(a) de Infraestrutura . Candidate-se agora e faça parte de uma equipe que transforma negócios e realiza sonhos!

  • Experiência sólida em administração, configuração e tunning de clusters Red Hat OpenShift em ambientes produtivos de larga escala;
  • Experiência prática em segurança e identidade utilizando RHBK (Red Hat Build of Keycloak) para gestão de acesso, federação de identidades e protocolos OAuth2/OIDC;
  • Conhecimento avançado em Infrastructure as Code utilizando Terraform e Ansible para automação de provisionamento e configuração;
  • Profundo conhecimento em containers e orquestração utilizando Kubernetes e Docker/Podman, incluindo service mesh como Istio ou Maistra;
  • Experiência na implementação de pipelines de CI/CD utilizando Tekton, ArgoCD ou Jenkins integrados ao ecossistema Red Hat;
  • Experiência em observabilidade com configuração de monitoramento, métricas, logs e alertas utilizando Prometheus, Grafana e ELK/EFK.


Requisitos adicionais:


  • Certificações Red Hat, como Red Hat Certified Specialist in OpenShift Administration ou equivalentes;
  • Experiência com OpenShift executando em provedores de nuvem pública como AWS, Azure ou GCP;
  • Familiaridade com frameworks de machine learning, como PyTorch e TensorFlow, aplicados ao suporte do OpenShift AI;
  • Conhecimento em segurança avançada e governança de clusters utilizando RHACS e RHACM;
  • Vivência com ferramentas de inteligência artificial, como ChatGPT, GitHub Copilot, plataformas de geração de imagens ou automação de processos, aplicadas a: Automatização de tarefas, criação de relatórios e análise de dados, apoio à tomada de decisão e inovação contínua, melhoria da eficiência operacional e qualidade das entregas.

  • Garantir a estabilidade, segurança e performance dos clusters OpenShift sob sua gestão;
  • Desenvolver e manter a arquitetura de autenticação e autorização utilizando RHBK;
  • Configurar e dar suporte ao OpenShift AI, preparando o ambiente para cientistas de dados e implantação de modelos em cenários de MLOps;
  • Criar e manter playbooks, pipelines e scripts de automação para assegurar infraestrutura replicável, resiliente e padronizada;
  • Atuar na resolução de incidentes complexos de infraestrutura e conectividade, realizando análise de causa raiz e propondo melhorias contínuas;
  • Apoiar e orientar tecnicamente o time de desenvolvimento na adoção de práticas cloud-native e na otimização do uso de recursos.

title: Salesforce Dev
description:
The professional will be responsible for administering, configuring, and implementing solutions on the Salesforce platform, as well as performing advanced customizations and Apex development. They will also provide user support, ensure data quality, and contribute to the continuous improvement of the environment.


Responsibilities

  • Administration and configuration of the platform: objects, fields, layouts, security, profiles, and permissions.
  • Customization and automation: validation rules, workflows, approval processes, Process Builder, and Flows.
  • Development: Apex (classes, triggers, controllers), Visualforce, SOQL/SOSL queries, and creation of test classes.
  • Integrations: use of REST/SOAP APIs, Connected Apps, and asynchronous methods (Batch, Queueable, Future).
  • Reports and dashboards: creation and maintenance of visualizations to support decision‑making.
  • Support and troubleshooting: debugging, user assistance, and guidance.
  • Tools: Data Loader, Ant Migration Tool, VS Code, and other Salesforce utilities.


Skills and Qualifications

  • Strong experience in Salesforce administration, configuration, and customization.
  • Hands-on experience with Apex, Visualforce, integrations, and automation tools.
  • Knowledge of Sales Cloud, Field Service, and CPQ.
  • Ability to translate business requirements into technical solutions.
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with stakeholders.
  • Proactive attitude with focus on best practices and high-quality code.


Nice to Have

  • Experience with Lightning (LDS, App Builder, Components).
  • Familiarity with Process Builder, Chatter, and Quick Actions.
  • Desired certifications: Administrator, Advanced Admin, App Builder, Platform Developer I.

title: Estagiário de Relações Internacionais
description:
Sobre o Bora Expandir:

Somos uma agência de viagens e assessoria de imigração especializada em auxiliar brasileiros que desejam morar na Espanha. Atuamos com vistos, autorizações de residência, cidadania, tradução juramentada, passagens e muito mais. Nosso propósito é ajudar nossos clientes a realizarem o sonho de viver na Europa com informação, planejamento e segurança jurídica.


O que você vai fazer aqui:

Estamos em busca de um(a) estagiário(a) que esteja cursado GRADUAÇÃO EM RELAÇÕES INTERNACIONAIS, com perfil proativo, comunicativo e com vontade de aprender. Você será treinado(a) para se tornar um especialista em imigração e fará parte de um time que transforma vidas!


As principais atividades incluem:

  • Atendimento ao cliente e análise de perfil migratório atráves de videochamadas
  • Organização e controle de documentos jurídicos e administrativos
  • Elaboração de protocolos e procedimentos administrativos (residências, vistos, nacionalidade etc.)
  • Apoio na análise de viabilidade de pedidos de regularização migratória
  • Participação em consultorias, com possibilidade de conduzir atendimentos após treinamento
  • Suporte em rotinas da assessoria jurídica administrativa voltada à estrangeiria na Espanha


Oferecemos:

  • Treinamento completo sobre os procedimentos migratórios da Espanha
  • Bolsa auxílio inicial de R$ 800, podendo chegar a R$ 1.500,00 - conforme a evolução
  • Jornada de 6 horas por dia (totalmente remoto)
  • Oportunidade real de efetivação, com aumento salarial, comissões e bonificações por desempenho


Requisitos:

  • Estar cursando Relações Innternacionais a partir do 6º período
  • Interesse pela área de Direito Internacional, Administrativo e de Imigração Espanhola
  • Boa comunicação oral e escrita
  • Desejável: conhecimento básico em espanhol (não eliminatório)
  • Essencial: ter notebook/computador com câmera e microfone em bom estado e ter espaço adequado para trabalho remoto - um espaço reservado e silencioso


Diferenciais:

  • Experiência anterior com atendimento ao público ou organização de processos jurídicos
  • Comunicação excelente (escrita e principalmente verbal)
  • Sem dificuldade para falar com cliente em videochamada (clareza, cordialidade e confiança)
  • Proatividade e senso de responsabilidade
  • Rapidez para aprender e colocar em prática
  • Facilidade em reconhecer documentos — saber “bater o olho” e identificar, por exemplo:
  • Certidão de nascimento
  • Certidão de casamento
  • Documento de união estável
  • Contrato social de empresa
  • Cartão CNPJ
  • Documento/Certificado de MEI
  • Apostilamento (Apostila de Haia)
  • etc.

title: Cientista de dados
description:
Venha para uma das maiores empresas de Serviços IT do mundo!! Aqui você pode transformar sua carreira!

Por que fazer parte da TCS? Aqui na TCS acreditamos que as pessoas fazem a diferença, por isso vivemos uma cultura de aprendizado ilimitado cheio de oportunidades de melhorias e desenvolvimento mútuo. O cenário ideal para expandir ideias através das ferramentas certas, contribuindo para nosso sucesso num ambiente colaborativo.

Mandatory skills:

Estamos buscando um Senior Data Scientist com ampla experiência em Python, Machine Learning e conhecimento avançado em componentes AWS para liderar projetos de análise de dados e desenvolvimento de soluções escaláveis.

Tecnologias como Deep Learning e GenAI serão consideradas diferenciais. Importante conter a tecnologia.

Conhecimento em GenAI (LLMs, Prompt Engineering, APIs como OpenAI, HuggingFace).

Inglês fluente.

Experiência com Deep Learning (TensorFlow, PyTorch). Experiência com modelos multimodais.

Experiência com a tecnologia chamada Kedro

Design, build, and deploy cloud-native automation workflows, including:

Azure: Functions, Logic Apps

AWS: Glue Jobs, Lambda, Step Functions, S3

Develop and maintain Cortex XSOAR playbooks, integrations, Python scripts, and automation modules tailored to process automation scenarios.

Create cross-platform orchestration pipelines (e.g., XSOAR → Azure → AWS) to support data flows, enrichment, and workflow execution.

Build reusable automation templates and components for repeatability and rapid iteration.

Implement automation CI/CD pipelines (Azure DevOps, GitHub Actions, AWS CodePipeline, etc.).

Ensure all automations adhere to ISRM quality standards, security requirements, and best practices.

Conduct testing, validation, and documentation of automation workflows.

Collaborate in Agile ceremonies and contribute to continuous improvement of the automation capability.

title: Analista de Sistemas Sênior
description:
Descrição:


  • Levantar e documentar os requisitos básicos para implementação de projetos novos e de sustentação de média e alta complexidade, participando de reuniões com o solicitante e demais envolvidos, visando garantir o entendimento e desenvolvimento da necessidade conforme esperado pelo negócio;
  • Realizar a modelagem dos dados de projetos de alta complexidade, definindo as informações necessárias e as respectivas bases de armazenamento e apoiar demais analistas em dúvidas sobre essa atividade, a fim de garantir a integridade e disponibilidade dos dados necessários para funcionamento da solução proposta;
  • Atuar na definição da arquitetura e proposta de solução, através da análise, detalhamento e especificação dos programas e componentes que farão parte da solução, visando possibilitar o desenvolvimento e atendimento da necessidade identificada;
  • Gerir o processo de testes e homologação, através da construção de roteiros de testes e homologação, execução e acompanhamento de testes unitários, testes de carga, testes integrados e apoio à homologação do usuário, visando a entrega dos projetos dentro dos critérios de qualidade estabelecidos;
  • Planejar e acompanhar a execução dos processos de implantação através da análise de riscos, elaboração de planos de contingência e rollback, levantamento das atividades, responsáveis e cronograma para implantação das soluções em ambiente de produção, visando garantir a comunicação, disponibilidade e segurança nas alterações de sistemas existentes e novos;
  • Atuar na identificação e solução de contorno e definitiva de problemas, através do atendimento de demandas, tarefas de ocorrências e incidentes, propondo melhorias e correções, visando garantir a disponibilidade, performance e confiabilidade dos sistemas;
  • Apoiar as áreas de negócio e demais áreas de desenvolvimento de sistemas na análise de viabilidade e orçamentação, através da proposição de soluções e análise de impacto e esforço, possibilitando a concepção de projetos de novos produtos e serviços.


Requisitos:

  • Formação superior em Ciência da Computação, Sistemas de Informação, Engenharia de Computação ou áreas afins;
  • Atuação sólida no desenvolvimento de soluções e projetos de TI;
  • Expertise em Levantamento de Requisitos, Análise e Arquitetura de Sistemas;
  • Atuação com modelagem de Banco de Dados Relacional;
  • Familiaridade com SQL Server e/ou DB2;
  • Sólida experiência com C# e ecossistema .NET;
  • Experiência com Metodologias Ágeis para entregas de alto valor.


Desejáveis:

  • Conhecimento em COBOL;
  • Inglês intermediário;

title: Senior Data Engineer

title: SAP MM Consultant
description:
We are looking for a highly experienced SAP WM/EWM professional with strong expertise in Supply Chain, Logistics Execution, and cross‑functional SAP environments. The ideal candidate will have extensive experience in SAP implementations, international supply chain processes, and interface management across global teams.


SAP Functional Expertise

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent work experience, with eight years working with SAP systems.
  • SAP WM / EWM expertise.
  • SAP LE (Logistics Execution).
  • Experience with IDocs, Interfaces, EDI, SAP PI.
  • Two full lifecycle SAP implementations required.
  • Development and maintenance of Supply Chain functionalities with focus on physical distribution, warehousing, and intercompany sales.
  • Solid experience in systems analysis, solution design, and configuration.
  • Ability to identify functional gaps and collaborate with technical teams to develop functional specifications.
  • Strong understanding of Supply Chain operations; international experience required .
  • Prior experience with SAP Warehouse and Sales & Distribution modules preferred.
  • Comfortable working in self‑directed environments and leading cross‑functional project teams.
  • Monitor IDocs interfaces; troubleshoot and resolve IDoc problems.
  • Understanding of EDI, SAP PI, and 3rd party logistics integrations (3PL, WMS, CHEP).
  • Support Business Unit requirements ensuring SAP configuration, development, and interfaces are maintained.
  • Work closely with business groups and application developers to support SAP ECC 6.0 and all related Supply Chain interfaces.

Process, Documentation & System Support

  • Conduct business process analysis, documentation, and presentations.
  • Translate end‑user requirements into detailed functional specifications.
  • Interact with users across sales, order processing, shipping, logistics, credit, A/R, finance, etc.
  • Re-engineer business processes when necessary; strong capability in process redesign.
  • Develop complete functional requirements including business impact and ROI.
  • Coordinate and support system conversions and data transfer activities.
  • Develop procedures, processes, and guidelines focused on quality and efficiency.
  • Skills in testing and evaluation of new ERP system functionalities.
  • Production support of existing ERP functionalities.
  • Troubleshoot and fix transaction errors with internal users, customers, and EDI vendors.
  • Conduct, coordinate, and be accountable for testing, user training, process documentation, and system validation.
  • Documentation ownership: Requirements, Design Specs, Testing, QA.
  • Provide SAP technical support for enhancements, new processes, break‑fixes, and 3rd party interfaces.

Cross-Functional Collaboration

  • Communicate effectively at all organizational levels.
  • Work closely with local and international business groups.
  • Assist Key Users in managing Work Requests (development, enhancements, production support), including:
  • Initial request assessment
  • Evaluation of need for additional assistance inside or outside the team
  • Following standard procedures for cross-team collaboration in Supply Chain
  • Provide support for cross-functional requests while working on Supply Chain tasks.
  • Experience with international trade, 3PL, warehousing interfaces, standard orders, 3rd‑party drop‑ship.
  • Demonstrated understanding of standard SAP-delivered process logic and process flows.
  • Participate in project work management, work request planning, and schedule creation.
  • Occasional domestic and international travel required.

Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent work experience.
  • Minimum 8 years of SAP experience.
  • SAP WM / EWM expertise (mandatory).
  • Strong SAP LE, IDocs, EDI, and SAP PI experience.
  • Secondary skills: SAP GTS / Foreign Trade, functional ABAP familiarity.
  • Strong Supply Chain acumen, with international experience.
  • Proven capability in business process redesign.
  • Ability to troubleshoot complex system and interface issues.
  • Strong documentation skills across requirements, design, testing, and QA.
  • Ability to lead cross-functional project teams.
  • Strong communication skills across all organizational levels.
  • Willingness and ability to travel when required.

Working Time

  • BRT timezone alignment with CST/EST acceptable.


What You Can Expect from Us

  • Professional development and continuous growth of your skills.
  • Opportunities to work on international assignments.
  • A collaborative, diverse, inclusive, and innovative environment that values teamwork.

title: Technical Delivery Team Manager
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics, a global IT solutions provider and trusted Oracle Partner, is dedicated to transforming enterprises with innovative, scalable, and future-ready solutions. Headquartered in London, UK, with a state-of-the-art development hub in Hyderabad, India, the company leverages a blend of expert business foresight and world-class technical talent. Specializing in Oracle Cloud and database technologies, MillionLogics offers a comprehensive range of services, including Data & AI, Cloud Solutions, IT Consulting, and Enterprise Applications. With a team of 45+ technology experts, MillionLogics is committed to delivering tailored, outcomes-driven solutions that help organizations thrive in the digital era. Learn more about their offerings at


Role Overview 

The Engineering Manager (EM) will be responsible for driving end-to-end delivery across multiple environments, ensuring timelines, quality, stakeholder communication, and execution discipline are maintained. This role will coordinate across PMs, QA, frontend, backend, data, and client-facing teams to ensure projects are delivered on time and with the expected quality.

The Engineering Manager will act as the central owner for delivery planning, risk management, issue escalation, resource coordination, and release readiness.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Own end-to-end delivery for assigned environments and ensure commitments are met
  • Create and manage delivery plans, timelines, trackers, and milestones
  • Align cross-functional teams (frontend, backend, QA, data, automation, PM) on priorities and dependencies
  • Track progress daily, identify delays early, and take corrective actions
  • Break down projects into phases with clear ownership and timelines
  • Manage risks, blockers, and bottlenecks; drive escalations and resolutions proactively
  • Coordinate with stakeholders and provide regular updates on progress, risks, and trade-offs
  • Ensure QA, data quality checks, automation, and documentation are complete before release
  • Conduct go/no-go reviews and ensure release readiness with all critical issues resolved
  • Track delivery metrics (timelines, defects, utilization, risks) and drive continuous improvement


Required skills

  • 8+ years of strong project and delivery management experience
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and cross-functional teams simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience with delivery planning, risk management, and escalation handling
  • Strong understanding of QA, engineering, and release processes
  • Ability to drive accountability and execution across teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with project tracking tools such as Jira, Asana, or similar


Preferred skills

  • Experience managing SaaS, workflow, enterprise, or RL environment projects
  • Familiarity with frontend, backend, QA, automation, and data workflows
  • Experience with resource planning and capacity management
  • Understanding of delivery metrics, harness reports, and quality dashboards
  • Experience working with global or client-facing teams


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Employment type  : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract :6 months (expected start date is next week)
  • Compensation : Competitive

title: Especialista em sistemas
description:
Olá Rede,


Somos uma empresa consolidada na área de Tecnologia e estamos em busca de um(a) Especialista de Sistemas Pleno (Java), vaga 100% remota.


Atividades incluem:

  • Desenvolver e implementar soluções, melhorias técnicas e metodológicas nos sistemas, avaliando, dimensionando e estabelecendo parâmetros que influenciam as tomadas de decisões técnicas, provendo assessoria e aconselhamento especializado, pesquisando e aplicando soluções inovadoras, projetando e arquitetando sistemas complexos, definindo tecnologias e ferramentas à serem usadas, sendo integrador de soluções e recursos multidisciplinares.
  • Desenvolver, projetar e arquitetar sistemas complexos, identificando e especificando aplicações alternativas de infra-estrutura, software e rede.
  • Pesquisar novos procedimentos, tecnologias e equipamentos, visando aplicar inovação para o desenvolvimento de sistemas para a organização.
  • Prover assessoria especializada e orientação aos colaboradores/usuários, no planejamento de projetos e desenvolvimento de sistemas de toda organização, softwares, diagnóstico e solução de problemas.
  • Monitorar e administrar o ambiente informatizado, através do monitoramento da performance do sistema e os recursos da rede, bem como o banco de dados e o ambiente operacional, visando identificar e corrigindo falhas no sistema, além de controlar o acesso aos dados e recursos e administrando o perfil de acesso às informações.
  • Oferecer soluções para ambientes informatizados, propondo mudanças de processos e funções, prestando consultoria técnica, identificando necessidades dos usuários, avaliando e negociando propostas de fornecedores.
  • Elaborar documentação para o ambiente informatizado, descrevendo, quando necessário, processos, desenhando diagrama de fluxos de informações, inventariando software, documentando estrutura da rede, níveis de serviço, capacidade e performance, assim como soluções disponíveis.
  • Buscar a melhoria contínua da qualidade, da sua área de atuação, através da identificação de oportunidades de melhoria dos processos e procedimentos.
  • Analisar, descrever, acompanhar, implementar projetos relacionados a tecnologia da informação, bem como atuar como Gerente de Projetos, utilizando as melhores práticas do mercado.


Para isso é necessário:

  • Superior em Análise de Sistemas, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação e ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em: Java, SQL, Openshift, Linux, API, Javascript/HTML/CSS, Shellscript, GIT, Spring Boot, JPA.
  • Conhecimento em Npm/Angular/React.
  • Desejável: Kubernetes, Redis, Jenkins, CI-CD, Docker-Compose.
  • Diferencial: Docker, ELK, C/CPP, RHSSO, KeyCloak.


Importante:

  • 100% Remota
  • Regime CLT | Jornada integral


Salário e Benefícios:

  • Faixa Salarial: entre R$ 12.500,00 e R$ 12.800,00
  • Benefícios: Assistência Médica, Odontológica, Vale Refeição, Seguro de Vida, PLR, Auxílio Creche, Wellhub, Cursos de Capacitação, Previdência Privada e Day Off.

title: DevOps Specialist - 132047
description:
O que buscamos:

Estamos em busca de uma pessoa Engenheira DevOps com forte experiência em Azure , Kubernetes (AKS) e práticas cloud-native , para dar suporte às operações diárias, automação, segurança e evolução da plataforma. Vaga remota e contratação CLT.


Responsabilidades:


  • Manter e evoluir clusters Kubernetes (com foco em AKS), incluindo provisionamento, atualizações, otimização, configuração e troubleshooting.
  • Implementar e otimizar pipelines de CI/CD usando Azure DevOps, incluindo build, testes automatizados, qualidade de código, segurança e estratégias de deploy.
  • Projetar e manter infraestrutura como código usando Crossplane e/ou Terraform.
  • Criar e manter Helm charts e manifests YAML.
  • Implementar e operar observabilidade usando o stack LGTM, definindo métricas, logs, dashboards e alertas para aplicações e infraestrutura.
  • Implementar e evoluir práticas de DevSecOps (varredura de vulnerabilidades em contêineres/imagens, SAST/DAST, políticas de segurança em pipelines e clusters).
  • Dar suporte à gestão diária dos ambientes: análise de incidentes, troubleshooting de performance, otimização de custos em Azure e suporte aos desenvolvedores.
  • Trabalhar em estreita colaboração com times de desenvolvimento, melhorando continuamente os processos do ciclo de vida de software (com foco em DevEx).


Requisitos:


  • Inglês avançado
  • Base sólida em Linux, TCP/IP, shell scripting, aplicações web/APIs e boas práticas de segurança.
  • Forte experiência com contêineres (Docker), incluindo construção de imagens distroless e boas práticas de segurança.
  • Forte experiência com Git e estratégias de versionamento.
  • Forte experiência com Kubernetes.
  • Experiência sólida na criação e manutenção de Helm charts.
  • Conhecimento de Azure e seus serviços relacionados a arquiteturas de referência para workloads AKS (Front Door, WAF, ingress público/privado).
  • Experiência com CI/CD usando Azure DevOps (pipelines YAML, pipelines multiestágio, templates, gates, aprovações, integrações externas, deploys).
  • Conhecimento em infraestrutura como código usando Crossplane ou Terraform.
  • Conhecimento do stack de observabilidade LGTM (Loki, Grafana, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/OpenTelemetry).
  • Familiaridade com conceitos de segurança em cloud e Kubernetes.


Diferenciais:


  • Experiência com outros provedores de nuvem: AWS, GCP, OCI.
  • Experiência com OpenShift ou outras plataformas de contêineres, como Kind, Minikube, K3D.
  • Experiência em desenvolvimento de software. Mesmo não atuando diretamente com código, entender como aplicações funcionam é essencial para projetar pipelines CI/CD eficientes e processos de provisionamento de infraestrutura.


Descrição comportamental:

Procuramos uma pessoa que:

title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are seeking an experienced Senior C# Developer to join a collaborative engineering team focused on enhancing Portfolio Management capabilities.


This role will partner closely with engineering, trading, risk, and operations teams to design and deliver scalable, high-performance solutions that improve portfolio transparency, accuracy, and operational efficiency across the firm. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in C#/.NET with a deep understanding of portfolio and position management concepts, and an interest in modern development practices including AI-enabled engineering and specification-driven development.


Responsibilities:

- Portfolio Management Enhancement

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve and extend portfolio management capabilities
  • Enhance portfolio aggregation, exposure calculation, and P&L reporting functionality
  • Improve intraday and end-of-day position workflows and controls
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives modernizing portfolio and position infrastructure


- Core Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services in C# / .NET
  • Contribute to the evolution of the Position Service architecture
  • Develop and enhance functionality within the Portfolio Management platform
  • Build scalable, resilient microservices supporting portfolio and order management workflows
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices


- AI & Intelligent Systems

  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI/ML and automation to enhance portfolio analytics, reconciliation, monitoring, and operational workflows
  • Collaborate on integrating AI-driven tools into the development lifecycle (e.g., intelligent code generation, review, testing, and documentation)
  • Contribute to the design of systems that enable advanced analytics and data-driven insights


- Specification-Driven Development


  • Promote and apply specification-driven development practices, including clear technical design documents and formalized functional requirements
  • Translate business requirements into precise system specifications prior to implementation
  • Ensure alignment between architecture, documentation, and delivered functionality
  • Improve development velocity and quality through stronger upfront design and validation processes


- System Design & Optimization


  • Improve system performance, scalability, and reliability
  • Optimize data processing pipelines and database interactions
  • Design and maintain robust APIs for internal consumers
  • Support both real-time and batch processing requirements


- Collaboration & Leadership


  • Work closely with portfolio managers, traders, risk, and operations teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Collaborate within the engineering team to drive architectural improvements
  • Participate in code reviews and mentor junior developers
  • Promote best practices in testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong expertise in C# and .NET (Core/Framework).
  • Experience building distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.
  • Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.
  • Strong SQL and database design experience.
  • Experience with messaging systems and asynchronous programming.
  • Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.
  • Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, and cost optimization
  • Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong team player.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.

  • Design and implement scalable backend services and APIs

  • Integrate and manage RPC-based data sources, designing resilient systems for rate-limited, high-throughput, and fault-tolerant data access

  • Monitor and maintain system health — defining SLOs, setting up alerting, and diagnosing performance bottlenecks across services and databases

  • Secure APIs and services against common vulnerabilities — injection, broken auth, and unauthorized access

  • Run security checks in CI/CD pipelines, maintain audit logs for sensitive operations, and set up rate limiting to protect against abuse
  • Maintain a workflow, continuously identify risks, review access controls, patch vulnerabilities, and improve defenses as systems evolve

title: Cloud Operations Engineer
description:
About Eightpoint


Eightpoint is an internet technology company specializing in the agile development of products and content that address real-world interests, captivating users and driving significant growth for partners. With offices in the United States and Cayman Islands, Eightpoint collaborates with partners globally on the next generation of user-centric offerings. Every product we launch is designed to engage users, enhance daily life, and deliver real-world value. Backed by data and driven by a relentless commitment to quality, Eightpoint moves fast, thinks big, and builds digital experiences that people love.


About the Role


The Cloud Operations Engineer will provide hands-on operational support across Eightpoint's multi-cloud infrastructure spanning AWS and GCP. This role focuses on maintaining reliability, supporting CI/CD pipelines, and ensuring observability across all environments while enabling the DevOps team to focus on project-driven initiatives. The position reports to the Director of IT & Cybersecurity and works closely with the DevOps and Systems Administration teams.


Key Responsibilities


  • Administer and support AWS infrastructure including EKS clusters, Elastic Beanstalk environments, EC2, S3, CloudFront, RDS, and IAM across a multi-account environment
  • Support GCP workloads, primarily BigQuery pipelines and related data infrastructure.
  • Maintain and troubleshoot self-hosted applications including Airflow, Grafana, and other internal tooling.
  • Support and maintain CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions, including self-hosted runners.
  • Participate in incident response processes — triage, root cause analysis, remediation, and post-incident documentation.
  • Deploy, configure, and maintain logging, monitoring, and alerting tooling (Grafana stack — Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy; CloudWatch; OneUptime).
  • Manage infrastructure-as-code using Terraform.
  • Participate in on-call rotation providing support across US and offshore time zones.
  • Contribute to documentation in Confluence and maintain runbooks for operational procedures.


Who You Are


  • 5+ years of experience in a cloud operations, DevOps, or infrastructure support role.
  • Strong working knowledge of AWS core services (EKS, Elastic Beanstalk, EC2, S3, IAM, VPC, RDS, CloudFront).
  • Hands-on experience administering containerized workloads (Kubernetes/EKS, Docker).
  • Experience building and maintaining CI/CD pipelines in GitHub Actions.
  • Demonstrated experience with incident response workflows — detection, escalation, remediation, and RCA.
  • Experience deploying and maintaining observability tooling (logging, metrics, tracing, alerting).
  • Proficiency in Linux administration and shell scripting (Bash, Python).
  • Strong experience with Terraform for infrastructure-as-code.
  • Experience with Atlassian tooling (Jira, JSM, Confluence).


Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with GCP, specifically BigQuery and related data services.
  • Experience with Grafana OSS stack (Loki, Tempo, Mimir, Alloy/Faro).
  • Experience supporting Airflow or similar orchestration platforms.
  • AWS certifications (Solutions Architect Associate, SysOps, or DevOps Engineer).
  • Experience working in multi-account AWS environments with consolidated billing/cost allocation tagging.
  • Exposure to ZTNA/VPN solutions (Firezone, Twingate, or similar).

title: Credit Risk Analyst
description:
Credit Risk Analyst — Acquisition & Online Lending

Full-time Contractor (PJ) | 100% Remote | US Central Time hours


⚠️ This is NOT an FP&A, Treasury, or Controller role. If your background is financial planning, accounting, or back-book portfolio management, this role is not a match.


Our US fintech client — an online consumer lender — is looking for a Credit Risk Analyst who owns the front end of the credit funnel. This means acquisition-side risk: designing risk tiers, sequencing underwriting decisions, managing approval/decline trade-offs at the top of funnel, and building the logic that determines who gets credit and at what terms — before any loan hits the books.


If you have hands-on experience with risk tiers, underwriting decision paths, dynamic acquisition pricing, or rescue lane strategies at an online lender, BNPL provider, or fintech — this role is built for you.


What You'll Do

• Optimize risk tiers and underwriting sequences for online customer acquisition

• Analyze precision/recall trade-offs in credit decisioning models to balance approval volume and loss rates

• Support or develop dynamic acquisition pricing strategies tied to risk performance

• Design and refine multiple underwriting pathways (multi-path sequencing)

• Build and monitor rescue lane strategies to recover near-miss applicants

• Track and report on front-end risk KPIs: approval rate, take rate, early delinquency, cost per funded loan

• Work closely with data and product teams to improve decision engine logic


Requirements (Non Negotiable)

• 3+ years of experience in online consumer lending, BNPL, or a tangential fintech/e-commerce credit environment

• Hands-on acquisition/top-of-funnel risk experience: risk tier assessment, underwriting sequencing, or dynamic acquisition pricing

• Fluent English — interviews, daily standups, and all written communication are in English

• SQL proficiency — comfortable writing queries independently to analyze credit performance data

• Ability to work US Central Time hours (approx. 9am–6pm CT / 11am–8pm Brasília)


Nice to Have

• Experience with rescue lane management or near-miss recovery programs

• Background in fraud risk within the acquisition funnel

• Exposure to multi-path underwriting logic or decision engine configuration

• Portfolio monitoring and credit loss forecasting (post-acquisition)

• Experience at an e-commerce, marketplace lending, or embedded finance company


What We Offer

• PJ/contractor arrangement — compensation aligned with fintech market rates

• 100% remote — work from anywhere in Brazil

• US Central Time schedule — structured workday, no late nights

• Direct exposure to a fast-growing US online lending operation


To apply, fill out the questions below. Responses in Portuguese will not be considered.

Assim, conseguimos nos manter próximos dos nossos clientes e consultores. Também somos uma Minority Owner Company e nos sentimos orgulhosos de termos nascido na diversidade.

O que esperar de nós

Pessoas estão no centro de nossa estratégia e compõem o nosso maior capital. Temos compromisso de atrair, reter os maiores e melhores talentos e construir conexões reais para a vida. Na Dexian, valorizamos a diversidade.

Acreditamos que diferentes perspectivas, experiências e trajetórias impulsionam a inovação e fortalecem conexões. Por isso, nosso processo de contratação é inclusivo, aberto a candidatos de todas as identidades, habilidades e histórias. Aqui, o que importa é o talento.

Você atuará em um projeto global de grande porte no segmento de energia, com ambiente SAP robusto e crítico, composto por aproximadamente 15 sistemas produtivos ECC e S/4HANA

  • Participação em escala de plantão (on-call rotativo)

O que você precisa ter

  • Experiência sólida em SAP Basis
  • Vivência com SAP S/4HANA e SAP HANA Database
  • Experiência com SAP NetWeaver (ABAP e Java)
  • Conhecimento em ferramentas como Solution Manager, Focused Run ou SAP LaMa
  • Experiência com troubleshooting, tuning e monitoramento de sistemas SAP
  • Conhecimento em backup & recovery
  • Experiência com replicação de dados (SLT)

  • Experiência com scripts (PowerShell ou Shell)

  • Inglês avançado (atuação global)

  • Vivência em projetos globais e ambientes complexos
  • Perfil proativo e colaborativo
  • Facilidade para atuar em times ágeis

Onde você vai trabalhar?

No conforto da sua casa. Regime 100% Home Office

title: Analista de Implantação - SAAS (Jr)
description:
Somos protagonistas na transformação digital dos meios de pagamento, somos a HST!

Desvendamos os desafios mais complexos e desde a nossa fundação temos a missão de tornar as transações eletrônicas mais seguras.

Estamos presentes em +20 Países e, dentre os nossos Clientes, estão os 8 Bancos mais importantes do Brasil e os 20 da América Latina!

São +80.000 terminais de autoatendimento; +1.000.000 autenticações de transações de compras eletrônicas ao mês; +800.000 cartões bancários com chip disponibilizados ao mês em lojas e agências bancárias; e até em 2024, foram +100 bancos utilizando nossos sistemas de emissor que permitem a tokenização de cartões COF (Card on File) e eCommerce. Para saber mais sobre a HST e sobre as nossas oportunidades, acesse:

Acreditamos ser importante que você já tenha passado por algumas experiências e que também tenha os seguintes conhecimentos:

  • Formação superior completa na área de tecnologia;
  • Experiência na área suporte/operações em atendimento ao cliente externo - nacional ou internacional;
  • Experiencia atuando em ambiente de trabalho na área de softwares com atividades de configuração, manutenção e treinamento de clientes;
  • Conhecimento e/ou vivência em troubleshooting e análise de logs;
  • Conhecimentos básicos em redes e protocolos de segurança;
  • Conhecimentos nos sistemas operacionais Windows e Linux.


Será um grande diferencial se:

  • Conhecimento básico ou contato prévio com Docker, Ansible, Apache e Kong;
  • Conhecimentos básicos de Scrum;
  • Conhecimento ou vivência em monitoração de serviços;
  • Vivência em atividades rotineiras de suporte e projetos, como acompanhamento, execução e atualização de tickets;
  • Noções de comunicação com o cliente e acompanhamento de indicadores (ex.: SLA, FCR, tempo de resposta, entre outros);
  • Espanhol e/ou Inglês em nível básico a intermediário;
  • Disponibilidade de atuar esporádicas vezes (uma vez a cada 30 ou 45 dias) presencialmente na sede da empresa, em Campinas/SP;
  • Conhecimento com produtos, ou com os conceitos relacionados com meios de pagamento.


O que oferecemos?

A HST é uma empresa certificada GPTW! Oferecemos a oportunidade de crescimento em um ambiente de desafios em que a contrapartida de cada Pessoa equivale ao tamanho da sua vontade de crescer !

title: Director of Studies
description:
TTA (The TEFL Academy), is the world’s largest TEFL (Teaching English as a Foreign Language) teacher training company. Over 15,000 English speakers complete our TEFL qualifications each year and start exciting careers teaching English abroad or online. Our alumni are working in over 100 countries, having life changing experiences, travelling the world and improving the lives of others.


We are looking for a remote Part-Time (20hrs per week) Director of Studies to join our team. You will be responsible for academic delivery and ensure excellence in teaching, assessment, and teacher development.


You will manage the teaching team, oversee lesson quality and assessment standards, and ensure that all academic processes align with industry best practices. You’ll play a critical role in teacher recruitment, training, curriculum development, and the ongoing professional development of our staff.


Key ResponsibilitiesAcademic Leadership

  • Provide strategic academic direction
  • Lead the development and continuous improvement of curricula and teaching resources
  • Maintain and raise academic quality standards across the programme

Team Management & Development

  • Recruit, train, and manage a team of TEFL trainers
  • Mentor newly qualified trainers, providing structured onboarding and ongoing support
  • Deliver in-house training and CPD sessions for teaching and assessment staff
  • Observe and assess teacher performance, offering developmental feedback

Assessment & Quality Assurance

  • Design, implement, and maintain clear assessment rubrics aligned with learning objectives
  • Monitor assessment consistency and integrity across the teaching team
  • Ensure timely, constructive feedback is provided to learners

Operational Oversight

  • Allocate teaching and assessment assignments efficiently
  • Manage timetabling logistics in line with teacher availability and learner demand
  • Coordinate with internal teams (e.g. tech, admin, student support) to ensure smooth academic operations
  • Use IT systems (including ticket lines and online teaching platforms) to manage workflows and communication

Problem-Solving & Communication

  • Take initiative in identifying and resolving academic or operational challenges
  • Communicate effectively with multiple departments to ensure alignment across functions
  • Adapt quickly to changing needs, especially during peak periods and across multiple time zones


RequirementsEssential:

  • TEFL qualification
  • DELTA or DipTESOL qualified
  • Extensive experience teaching General English to adults online & in-person
  • Proven track record in teacher training, mentoring, and academic leadership
  • Experience observing and assessing teaching practices
  • Strong background in academic scheduling and operations
  • Strong digital literacy and comfort using educational platforms and IT systems
  • Excellent organizational, communication, and interpersonal skills
  • Ability to problem-solve and adapt in a fast-paced, remote working environment


Desirable:

  • Previous experience as a Director of Studies or in a similar academic leadership role
  • Experience managing remote teams and asynchronous workflows
  • Background in recruiting and managing academic staff


What We Offer

  • A senior leadership role in a dynamic, growing international education company
  • Opportunities for professional development and career progression
  • Fully remote working arrangement
  • Flexible working hours, particularly during off-peak periods

title: Senior Principal Software Engineer
description:
Project Description:

We are seeking an experienced Senior C# Developer to join a collaborative engineering team focused on enhancing Portfolio Management capabilities.


This role will partner closely with engineering, trading, risk, and operations teams to design and deliver scalable, high-performance solutions that improve portfolio transparency, accuracy, and operational efficiency across the firm. The ideal candidate combines strong technical expertise in C#/.NET with a deep understanding of portfolio and position management concepts, and an interest in modern development practices including AI-enabled engineering and specification-driven development.


Responsibilities:

- Portfolio Management Enhancement

  • Partner with cross-functional teams to improve and extend portfolio management capabilities
  • Enhance portfolio aggregation, exposure calculation, and P&L reporting functionality
  • Improve intraday and end-of-day position workflows and controls
  • Contribute to strategic initiatives modernizing portfolio and position infrastructure


- Core Development

  • Design, develop, and maintain high-performance services in C# / .NET
  • Contribute to the evolution of the Position Service architecture
  • Develop and enhance functionality within the Portfolio Management platform
  • Build scalable, resilient microservices supporting portfolio and order management workflows
  • Write clean, maintainable, and well-tested code following engineering best practices


- AI & Intelligent Systems

  • Identify opportunities to leverage AI/ML and automation to enhance portfolio analytics, reconciliation, monitoring, and operational workflows
  • Collaborate on integrating AI-driven tools into the development lifecycle (e.g., intelligent code generation, review, testing, and documentation)
  • Contribute to the design of systems that enable advanced analytics and data-driven insights


- Specification-Driven Development


  • Promote and apply specification-driven development practices, including clear technical design documents and formalized functional requirements
  • Translate business requirements into precise system specifications prior to implementation
  • Ensure alignment between architecture, documentation, and delivered functionality
  • Improve development velocity and quality through stronger upfront design and validation processes


- System Design & Optimization


  • Improve system performance, scalability, and reliability
  • Optimize data processing pipelines and database interactions
  • Design and maintain robust APIs for internal consumers
  • Support both real-time and batch processing requirements


- Collaboration & Leadership


  • Work closely with portfolio managers, traders, risk, and operations teams to translate business requirements into technical solutions
  • Collaborate within the engineering team to drive architectural improvements
  • Participate in code reviews and mentor junior developers
  • Promote best practices in testing, CI/CD, monitoring, and observability


Mandatory Skills Description:

  • 7+ years of professional software development experience.
  • Strong expertise in C# and .NET (Core/Framework).
  • Experience building distributed systems and service-oriented architectures.
  • Full lifecycle experience including requirements gathering, implementation, testing, release, and support.
  • Strong SQL and database design experience.
  • Experience with messaging systems and asynchronous programming.
  • Independent mindset, passion for technology, and an appetite for taking ownership, learning new technologies, and building innovative products.
  • Experience in Cloud (Azure/AWS/GCP) experience involving stateless and serverless solutions, and cost optimization
  • Exposure to multi-threaded programming concepts.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Strong team player.
  • Bachelor's degree in computer science or engineering.

title: Technical Delivery Team Manager
description:
Company Description

MillionLogics, a global IT solutions provider and trusted Oracle Partner, is dedicated to transforming enterprises with innovative, scalable, and future-ready solutions. Headquartered in London, UK, with a state-of-the-art development hub in Hyderabad, India, the company leverages a blend of expert business foresight and world-class technical talent. Specializing in Oracle Cloud and database technologies, MillionLogics offers a comprehensive range of services, including Data & AI, Cloud Solutions, IT Consulting, and Enterprise Applications. With a team of 45+ technology experts, MillionLogics is committed to delivering tailored, outcomes-driven solutions that help organizations thrive in the digital era. Learn more about their offerings at


Role Overview 

The Engineering Manager (EM) will be responsible for driving end-to-end delivery across multiple environments, ensuring timelines, quality, stakeholder communication, and execution discipline are maintained. This role will coordinate across PMs, QA, frontend, backend, data, and client-facing teams to ensure projects are delivered on time and with the expected quality.

The Engineering Manager will act as the central owner for delivery planning, risk management, issue escalation, resource coordination, and release readiness.


What does day-to-day life look like?

  • Own end-to-end delivery for assigned environments and ensure commitments are met
  • Create and manage delivery plans, timelines, trackers, and milestones
  • Align cross-functional teams (frontend, backend, QA, data, automation, PM) on priorities and dependencies
  • Track progress daily, identify delays early, and take corrective actions
  • Break down projects into phases with clear ownership and timelines
  • Manage risks, blockers, and bottlenecks; drive escalations and resolutions proactively
  • Coordinate with stakeholders and provide regular updates on progress, risks, and trade-offs
  • Ensure QA, data quality checks, automation, and documentation are complete before release
  • Conduct go/no-go reviews and ensure release readiness with all critical issues resolved
  • Track delivery metrics (timelines, defects, utilization, risks) and drive continuous improvement


Required skills

  • 8+ years of strong project and delivery management experience
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and cross-functional teams simultaneously
  • Strong stakeholder management and communication skills
  • Experience with delivery planning, risk management, and escalation handling
  • Strong understanding of QA, engineering, and release processes
  • Ability to drive accountability and execution across teams
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills
  • Experience with project tracking tools such as Jira, Asana, or similar


Preferred skills

  • Experience managing SaaS, workflow, enterprise, or RL environment projects
  • Familiarity with frontend, backend, QA, automation, and data workflows
  • Experience with resource planning and capacity management
  • Understanding of delivery metrics, harness reports, and quality dashboards
  • Experience working with global or client-facing teams


Offer Details:

  • Commitments Required: 8 hours per day with overlap of 4 hours with PST.
  • Employment type  : Contractor assignment (no medical/paid leave)
  • Duration of contract :6 months (expected start date is next week)
  • Compensation : Competitive

description:

Atividades incluem:

  • Desenvolver e implementar soluções, melhorias técnicas e metodológicas nos sistemas, avaliando, dimensionando e estabelecendo parâmetros que influenciam as tomadas de decisões técnicas, provendo assessoria e aconselhamento especializado, pesquisando e aplicando soluções inovadoras, projetando e arquitetando sistemas complexos, definindo tecnologias e ferramentas à serem usadas, sendo integrador de soluções e recursos multidisciplinares.
  • Desenvolver, projetar e arquitetar sistemas complexos, identificando e especificando aplicações alternativas de infra-estrutura, software e rede.
  • Pesquisar novos procedimentos, tecnologias e equipamentos, visando aplicar inovação para o desenvolvimento de sistemas para a organização.
  • Prover assessoria especializada e orientação aos colaboradores/usuários, no planejamento de projetos e desenvolvimento de sistemas de toda organização, softwares, diagnóstico e solução de problemas.
  • Monitorar e administrar o ambiente informatizado, através do monitoramento da performance do sistema e os recursos da rede, bem como o banco de dados e o ambiente operacional, visando identificar e corrigindo falhas no sistema, além de controlar o acesso aos dados e recursos e administrando o perfil de acesso às informações.
  • Oferecer soluções para ambientes informatizados, propondo mudanças de processos e funções, prestando consultoria técnica, identificando necessidades dos usuários, avaliando e negociando propostas de fornecedores.
  • Elaborar documentação para o ambiente informatizado, descrevendo, quando necessário, processos, desenhando diagrama de fluxos de informações, inventariando software, documentando estrutura da rede, níveis de serviço, capacidade e performance, assim como soluções disponíveis.
  • Buscar a melhoria contínua da qualidade, da sua área de atuação, através da identificação de oportunidades de melhoria dos processos e procedimentos.
  • Analisar, descrever, acompanhar, implementar projetos relacionados a tecnologia da informação, bem como atuar como Gerente de Projetos, utilizando as melhores práticas do mercado.


Para isso é necessário:

  • Superior em Análise de Sistemas, Tecnologia da Informação ou áreas correlatas.
  • Superior completo em Tecnologia da Informação e ou áreas correlatas.
  • Experiência em: Java, SQL, Openshift, Linux, API, Javascript/HTML/CSS, Shellscript, GIT, Spring Boot, JPA.
  • Conhecimento em Npm/Angular/React.
  • Desejável: Kubernetes, Redis, Jenkins, CI-CD, Docker-Compose.
  • Diferencial: Docker, ELK, C/CPP, RHSSO, KeyCloak.


Importante:

  • 100% Remota
  • Regime CLT | Jornada integral


Salário e Benefícios:

  • Faixa Salarial: entre R$ 12.500,00 e R$ 12.800,00
  • Benefícios: Assistência Médica, Odontológica, Vale Refeição, Seguro de Vida, PLR, Auxílio Creche, Wellhub, Cursos de Capacitação, Previdência Privada e Day Off.

description:

title: Salesforce Software Engineer
description:
We are hiring experienced Software Engineers  to join our team and build on the Salesforce platform. These are hands-on engineering roles — you will be writing code, designing solutions, and shipping features across a large, mature codebase. We are not looking for administrators or declarative-only builders; we need engineers who think in code and architecture.

We're hiring across both UI/Frontend  and Backend/Platform  specializations, and you'll work on a production Experience Cloud site built with Lightning Web Components (LWC) and Bootstrap, supported by a robust backend of Apex services, integrations, and asynchronous processing.



What You'll Work On


Frontend / UI Engineers  will focus on:

  • Building and maintaining Lightning Web Components within an Experience Cloud site serving external users
  • Working with Bootstrap-based styling and responsive layouts alongside the LWC framework
  • Designing component architectures that are performant, accessible, and maintainable at scale
  • Integrating frontend components with Apex controllers, platform events, and real-time data flows

Backend / Platform Engineers  will focus on:

  • Designing and building Apex services, triggers, and automation across a complex data model
  • Implementing and maintaining asynchronous processing patterns including Queueable Apex, Batchable Apex, and Platform Events
  • Working with the Connect API and other Salesforce platform APIs
  • Building and supporting MuleSoft integrations for document processing and connectivity to external systems
  • Ensuring governor limit compliance, bulkification, and performance optimization across high-volume operations

All engineers  will contribute to code reviews, technical design discussions, and continuous improvement of our engineering practices.



Required Qualifications


  • Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or a related technical discipline — we value a strong foundation in data structures, algorithms, systems design, and software engineering principles
  • 5+ years of professional software engineering experience , with a meaningful portion spent writing code on the Salesforce platform (Apex, LWC, SOQL/SOSL, Visualforce)
  • Demonstrated experience building large-scale applications  — you've worked in codebases with significant complexity, not just small apps or proof-of-concept projects
  • Experience building cloud-native or cloud-hosted applications  — you understand multi-tenant architecture, API-driven design, and the tradeoffs of building on a managed platform
  • Proficiency with modern AI-assisted development tools  (e.g., GitHub Copilot, Claude, Cursor, or similar) — you actively use AI to accelerate coding, debugging, and code review, and you understand how to validate and guide AI-generated output effectively
  • Strong understanding of software engineering fundamentals : version control (Git), testing strategies, CI/CD, separation of concerns, and clean code practices



Preferred Qualifications


  • Experience with Salesforce Experience Cloud  (Community Cloud) site development
  • Hands-on experience with Lightning Web Components (LWC)  in production
  • Experience with MuleSoft  (Anypoint Platform, API-led connectivity, CloudHub)
  • Familiarity with Platform Events  and event-driven architecture on Salesforce
  • Experience with Batchable and Queueable Apex  patterns for high-volume data processing
  • Working knowledge of the Salesforce Connect API
  • Salesforce certifications such as Platform Developer I/II  (valued but not required — we care more about what you can build than what you've passed)
  • Experience with Bootstrap  or similar CSS frameworks in the context of LWC development
  • Familiarity with document processing pipelines and integration patterns

title: Senior AirTable Engineer
description:
Senior AirTable Engineer

Brazil

Software Engineer II


Important Information

Location: Brazil

Job Mode: Full-time

Work Mode: Work from home

Job Summary


We are seeking a Senior Airtable Engineer with a proven track record in designing, architecting, and scaling mission-critical business systems built on Airtable. This is a hands-on technical role focused on building and maintaining robust, secure, and scalable Airtable-based operational platforms that power loan origination, underwriting, servicing, and internal workflows. The ideal candidate combines strong Airtable architecture expertise with automation, API integrations, third- party software integrations, data modeling, and process design skills, and can collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to translate business requirements into elegant, efficient, scalable systems.

Responsibilities and Duties


  • Design, architect, and maintain scalable Airtable bases and data models supporting loan origination, underwriting, servicing, capital markets, and operations;
  • Build advanced Airtable automations, scripts, and integrations using Airtable Scripting, JavaScript, and APIs;
  • Develop and maintain integrations between Airtable and third-party systems (e.g., CRM, loan management systems, document management platforms, accounting systems, and data warehouses);
  • Propose and deploy best-in-class third-party software integrations to support required business workflows and technical programming that are limited using native Airtable functionality exclusively
  • Implement data governance standards including permissions, access control, field-level security, naming conventions, and documentation;
  • Optimize Airtable performance, scalability, and reliability for high-volume transactional workflows;
  • Collaborate closely with Operations, Capital Markets, Finance, Data & Quality, and Engineering teams to gather requirements and implement scalable solutions;
  • Support system monitoring, troubleshooting, and ongoing enhancements.

Essential Skills


  • Experience designing and implementing complex Airtable architectures in production environments;
  • Deep expertise in data modeling and relational database design, automations and scripting using JavaScript, Interfaces and advanced workflow design, and permissions, governance, and enterprise-level structure;
  • Strong understanding of API integrations (RESTful APIs, webhooks, middleware such as Zapier and Make);
  • Proficiency in JavaScript for automation and integration scripting;
  • Experience integrating Airtable with external systems such as CRM platforms, loan management systems, accounting software, or document storage systems.

Highly Desirable Skills


  • Experience building fintech, lending, or financial operations systems;
  • Experience with Salesforce CRM and integration;
  • Experience designing operational systems for loan origination or underwriting workflows.

With over 9,000 experts in 47+ offices and innovation labs worldwide, Encora’s technology practices include Product Engineering & Development, Cloud Services, Quality Engineering, DevSecOps, Data & Analytics, Digital Experience, Cybersecurity, and AI & LLM Engineering.
